Fellow Conservative,

Have you ever believed in something so strongly, that you’re willing to give up everything?

**_My family did and I am thankful every day for their sacrifice._**

I was born in Havana, Cuba, and escaped Castro's Communist Revolution with my family in 1960. I grew up watching a communist dictator destroy my native country. Our family friends who remained were forced to ration food and were oppressed every single day. But Fellow Conservative, I’ve always believed that my life is blessed – and I am grateful every day that my parents risked everything to make sure that we grew up in America where we could be free! They took a chance and together, we made it to the United States.

My parents came here with nothing but through hard work they were able to provide the example and the foundation for me to live the American Dream.

**I am living proof that the American dream is real!**

[**My name is Leora Levy and I’m running for the United States Senate.**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=4cf59adc50d845baab099fad6cc5b9ca&_e=ed4nqBz75ausMJf_fZ1XL4wD2E9egsHTP7I9UyCw0phbgLM4RBpYy94u5kMawTYGBqPOebHgFB1KqyM7Orx60_HHKiJmVzUoDpIATd6UcY_zeFv-APa-OQfSho4FVnAmjAAWdS-fUX33nh2mc8I6IgfDLwbiESyhbQ4bJqGkr98VdH3arBkXNYnxLIAkb-b0oXxV_0_AtJr5T0urmPOtpErFInqWwH2kuDsHxghDf9-jGc53jvpo4p4o91265gSbsn0SKUVVI5d2u92ebaKezPv6hdawWVdXfG1Ocg-Ig23AJJlGSA3dMHAyFlAq7PbEXzhdYWpcgwIKLKL3fDmvYGGFMbZJMd4YjEtpsncy1Rn7t80_ZFmr2rz5dZxtfedEmwUIMWN2FX-bw0FmdFneaKi-ubm2Wngni5rbnym5wCXRN439tN5BKpOmVKJssdLVeti_FzNyeo9uOTnEYa12xQ%3D%3D) I am running to lead the fight for freedom and to take on the far-left who want to make our country look more like Communist Cuba than the United States.

For too long, Democrats in Congress have sought to undermine our freedoms and destroy the very fabric of America. I am committed to leading the fight for American Freedom promised to us by our Constitution - because I know first-hand what it’s like when you lose it.

Think about this: in the first year of Joe Biden’s presidency, we have experienced record-setting inflation and fuel prices, and encountered utter disregard for our country's founding principles, faced a humiliating and deadly retreat from Afghanistan, leaving Americans behind and losing 13 brave American soldiers... _and this is just the beginning._

subject: Are They Tone Deaf?
body:

## Are They Tone Deaf?
### Wednesday, May 4th 2022
Friend, This election year is shaping up to be a BIG YEAR for conservatives. But that's only if we secure our elections, and **election integrity starts at home**! So why on earth is the Republican Party of Minnesota's Chair using a dominion-like electronic voting machine for the important State Convention next week?!?! Candidates for Governor and Secretary of State pushed for paper ballots and it seemed the majority of the delegates are in support of their calls. Paper ballots have long been a staple of **free and fair** elections, while electronic machines have rigged and destroyed elections. MNGOP Chairman David Hann sent an email out to the GOP State Convention delegates this morning discrediting the calls for paper ballots by conservatives. Hann is at great odds with the conservative base who abhor electronic voting machines. **In fact, the voting machines that they are going to use don't even allow an audit trail. Unbelievable!** [](https://www.action4liberty.com/mngop_to_use_dominion_like_electronic_voting_at_state_convention?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=are_they_tone_deaf&n=2) You can read Chairman Hann's email [here](https://www.action4liberty.com/mngop_to_use_dominion_like_electronic_voting_at_state_convention?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=are_they_tone_deaf&n=3). Worse yet, the vendor of the electronic voting machines has donated to the Democratic Party, which adds to the concerns. **Luckily, State Conventions belong to the delegates and this tone deaf move by the Party officials can be overturned by a majority of delegates during the approval of convention rules.** We MUST DEMAND our elections are secure!

body:
Thanks for the shoutout, guys.
#
Oh no, Derek, they got me!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220504-2?refcode=em20220504-5663&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=5663_434096_FGYYwT&akid=5663%2E434096%2EFGYYwT)
What can I say? It's true.
**I’m 100% in favor of scrapping the filibuster to codify**** _Roe v. Wade,_****because I believe the right to an abortion is sacred.**
In fact, I’ve believed that for as *long* as I’ve been in politics.
Psst, RNC Research Team, I even dug up this clip for you to make things easier! 😂👇
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220504-2?refcode=em20220504-5663&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=5663_434096_FGYYwT&akid=5663%2E434096%2EFGYYwT)
But really, I couldn’t be more serious. Every Pennsylvanian — every American — should have power over their own bodies + own lives. I’ll say it again + again + again, and when you send me to the U.S. Senate, I’ll proudly cast the 51st vote Democrats need to protect the right to choose.
[**Derek, this race could decide whether or not Democrats can codify _Roe_ into law. Make a donation of any amount today to help us win this race, flip this seat, and permanently protect the right to an abortion. **](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220504-2?refcode=em20220504-5663&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=5663_434096_FGYYwT&akid=5663%2E434096%2EFGYYwT)

My Republican opponents in this race want to end abortion nationwide. I want to protect it.**And our race here in PA could determine control of the U.S. Senate.**
With the stakes this high, there’s no other team I’d want to have on my side. Thanks for being part of this, Derek. 🙏
—John

name: Matt Dolan
subject: Thank you
body:
My friend,

With the Republican Primary now concluded, Jessica and I wanted to send along
a personal note of thanks to all our volunteers, supporters, and donors. We
have been humbled beyond words by the hard work of our team and all who
generously gave their time, resources, and prayers to this effort.

JD Vance and I have debated our differences, and as I said in my statement on
Election Day, he was successful in this hard-fought campaign. I know we share
a love for our country because it’s not just an exceptional nation, but an
idea, and a cause worth fighting for. Ohio Republicans have spoken and now it’s
time to look forward, united in our conservative convictions to make Ohio and
America a better place to live, work, and raise a family.

During the primary, I had the opportunity to visit with Ohioans in every
region of our beautiful state. You opened up your homes, businesses, and
hearts. You took a chance on a kid from Cleveland who spent much of the race
behind, and never lost faith in our effort. We embraced truth and a positive
conservative agenda that will build a stronger, freer nation.

I, and my competitors for this nomination, heard Ohioans loud and clear. The
livelihoods of our families, workers and businesses remain under threat by the
broken promises and weak leadership of radicalized, one-party rule in
Washington, D.C. Those fortunate to have a job are working harder for less.
Congressman Tim Ryan votes with Joe Biden 100 percent of the time. He
represents a continuation of the same failed policies that undermine
prosperity, threaten Ohio workers, and restrain the vitality of American
competition with China. Just as I will never quit fighting for Ohio, I pledge
to unite our party and endorse JD Vance to be our next U.S. Senator.

From Day 1, I promised that I would make this race about Ohio, because Ohio
matters. That doesn’t happen without all of you believing in this effort as
well. It has been an honor to lead this charge and to stand with pride for our
state. The Primary is over, but the cause endures. Thank you, once again, for
your vote, and trust in my candidacy.

Sincerely,

Matt Dolan

The livelihoods of our families, workers and businesses remain under threat by the broken promises and weak leadership of radicalized, one-party rule in Washington, D.C. Those fortunate to have a job are working harder for less. Congressman Tim Ryan votes with Joe Biden 100 percent of the time. He represents a continuation of the same failed policies that undermine prosperity, threaten Ohio workers, and restrain the vitality of American competition with China. Just as I will never quit fighting for Ohio, I pledge to unite our party and endorse JD Vance to be our next U.S. Senator. From Day 1, I promised that I would make this race about Ohio, because Ohio matters. That doesn’t happen without all of you believing in this effort as well. It has been an honor to lead this charge and to stand with pride for our state. The Primary is over, but the cause endures. Thank you, once again, for your vote, and trust in my candidacy. Sincerely, Matt Dolan

| | My mother didn't have a choice when she was raped at 13 and forced to give birth at 14. Girls as young as 11 are forced to give birth each year in our country, despite the health risks and trauma to the pregnant child. History does not judge kindly the regimes who steal individual freedoms and denigrate its most vulnerable populations. These are the same types of regimes like those in Northern Africa, who believe female genital mutilation is a divine and protected right; The same types of government like that of China, whose strict family planning policies have always drawn fierce criticism from across the world; the same authoritarian extremism that enabled forced sterilization during Nazi Germany, and enables it today in Bangladesh; The kind of hatred for women that results in legalized rape in Malaysia, and child marriage in the United States. As outraged as we have been over these crimes against girls and women globally, Americans have been able to find some level of comfort knowing our country did not see women as property of their husbands or of the state, but as Americans granted every equal right under the law. The dark shadow cast upon our nation by the perversion exhibited in Alito's statement extends far beyond termination of pregnancy, and threatens more than a century of legal precedent - precedent that recognized our rights to contraception, adoption, IVF, treatment for ectopic pregnancies, and freedom from jail for women who miscarry. Yet in its statement vilifying women for the audacity of existing, the Court made no restrictions to child marriage, still legal in all but four states. A 74 year old man legally married a 14 year old girl in Alabama. A 10 year old girl legally married a 31 year man in Tennessee. Yet the court is silent on these legal abuses happening to children already born. The court draft opinion goes further still and challenges the standing of interracial marriage, gay marriage, and specific sex acts between consenting adults. The Court's apparent disdain for the right of any individual to maintain legal ownership of their own body is an affront to our God-given right to liberty and justice. Laws governing sex, pregnancy and marriage across the world overwhelmingly target girls and women in a manner that can only be discrimination on the basis of sex. And when Roe dies, the dignity of women dies with it. Without empathy, without compassion, without reason or justification, they seek to make all females of child-bearing age property of the state. A majority-male court, including two known sexual predators, one justice who likely conspired to commit treason against the United States, and at least one religious fanatic; judges mostly picked by Presidents who lost the popular vote; and, confirmed by senators representing far less than half the population, plan to strip every female in this country of control over their own bodies. To every woman grieving the loss of our freedom, autonomy, and our inalienable rights, I give you this advice: Run for office. Run against the anti-Roe zealots in every office they hold, from school board to congress. Find an uncontested race with an anti-Roe candidate or incumbent and contest it. If you can't run, support the women who are running through donations, volunteering, petitioning, sharing our pages, supporting us in your groups, and championing the rights of girls and women in all facets, across all geographies, all of the time. We now inherit the fight of our mothers and our grandmothers for justice and fair treatment under the law. We can not afford to let them, ourselves, our daughters or our country down. We're losing daylight. The long night approaches, and we need to elect those who have shown they are able and willing to fight for more than just themselves. name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Have you seen this?
body:
|
---
| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I don't believe the majority of the public really knows what is being taught to our children and grandchildren. They assume they are taught the same lessons we learned growing up--that America is a land of freedom and opportunity where anyone has a chance at success. From what I've seen, this isn't always the case. [**However, I want to know what you 've seen.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60312380:JZDlDDoN-:m:1:3317145305:93D8092194513661518107128F8389BD:r) [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60312380:JZDlDDoN-:m:1:3317145305:93D8092194513661518107128F8389BD:r)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ I believe that **children as young as elementary age are being taught to reject our American values.** They are told that our Founding Fathers were massively flawed and that it overshadows the nation they built. They hear that our Constitution is "out of date" and needs to be "modernized." Progressives are rewriting our nation's history and they are doing it with our youngest and most vulnerable. We cannot let this happen! This year I'm going to be meeting with political leaders and educational "experts" across the country. **I 'm going to make sure people know what is really happening in our schools. ** I want to be able to share with them the thoughts of people who are closest to the issue. [**Specifically, I would like to include your thoughts.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60312380:JZDlDDoN-:m:1:3317145305:93D8092194513661518107128F8389BD:r) The American Cornerstone Institute, a nonprofit I recently founded, has created a unique survey. We're trying to gauge the state of America's Educational System by surveying people like you. I'd like to ask you to give me 2 minutes of your time so we can better understand the problems that exist in our educational system. You can access the survey here...

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/education_survey/](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60312380:JZDlDDoN-:m:1:3317145305:93D8092194513661518107128F8389BD:r) Thank you for your consideration. Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Ben Shapiro
subject: 9 Antifa Leftists arrested
body:
Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. It’s never been more important that we expose it, because
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z55tj0dhgdb4qkuohbuvfqnermhq91nt066i7n80_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8cdks1g7cstke6pn1ohjeaoe6o36eior5clkcgomcs3l65obbchmmaonaopjc1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omccbn6mp6fdr0cpq61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
Fellow Patriot, Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. It’s never been more important that we expose it, because the Left has lit an ideological fire, and that fire is now consuming the minds of young Americans, burning itself through the most aspects of American culture and politics. That’s why it’s of utmost importance that I hear back from you today. I’m no stranger to the authoritarian attitudes on campus; I famously felt the brunt of it when conservative students invited me to speak on the University of California, Berkeley campus. [**HELP US FIGHT THE RADICAL LEFT**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9ispe0erqlra6s3qq6u1akm5tc8a2vfp1tl6pl0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs) Radical leftist groups like Antifa vowed to riot and cause harm to others. The fear of violence from leftist agitators was so great that:
* It cost $600,000 in security expenses and required hundreds of policemen to ensure that agitators didn’t disrupt or try to cause violence at my speech.
* The University shut down six buildings on campus during my speech and erected concrete barricades (YES, a wall) to secure the Berkeley campus.
* For the first time in 20 years, the City of Berkeley voted to allow the use of pepper spray against violent protesters.
* In the end, police arrested nine leftists for trying to sneak banned weapons into our event—with the likely intent to do harm.

It’s no longer just about the Left trying to suppress your conservative views on campus. It’s about using the threat of violence to silence the conservative values you and I share. Meanwhile, schools roll out the red carpet for leftists like Angela Davis, Bill Ayers, Barack Obama, Bill Clinton, and Bernie Sanders. At Berkeley, taxpayer-funded school administrators tried to derail my event from even taking place. They told me that they didn’t have a lecture hall available, which was a lie. School administrators even cut the venue in half by not allowing students to sit in the balcony—a dirty tactic to minimize attendance. _**The good news is the radical Left’s attempts to silence me completely backfired.**_**** More than 600 students showed up, and we were able to host an engaging and civil event. Then, OVER 10 MILLION PEOPLE watched my speech online (that’s more viewers than any of the major evening newscasts). This victory for the Conservative Movement would have never happened if it weren’t for the **Young America’s Foundation** **(YAF)**. When Berkeley tried to illegally block me from coming to campus, YAF sued the university —**and won.** But the radicals who rioted and tried to incite violence at Berkeley are relentless. Their stranglehold on America’s universities has not yet been broken. **Young America’s Foundation** has been an incredible partner in making sure I am able to share our conservative values with students on campuses across the country. In fact, I speak on campuses **_exclusively_** through YAF because I know YAF has the experience and leadership necessary to run the nation’s leading campus lecture program. Today YAF needs your help. **[Will you contribute $35 today to ensure that YAF can continue to present speakers, including Dr. Arthur Laffer, Katie Pavlich, Senator Ted Cruz, and many others to high school and college students? Without you, the mission to pass along our conservative values to future generations will stall out.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z56stpud9alehelm0iojs9ej3en6jsicb8t98iq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs)** Let me tell you a little bit more about what YAF does to advance conservative ideas. Speaking to an audience of Young America’s Foundation students, Vice President Mike Pence noted, “Since its founding in 1960, YAF has been a bulwark of American greatness.” YAF valiantly defends the values we share by educating impressionable young people who have been ideologically poisoned by leftist propaganda for decades, by the very teachers and professors they’re told to trust. YAF’s team is the best at what they do. They are _**#1: the LARGEST and MOST effective conservative youth outreach organization in America**._ Here’s why:
* YAF introduces young audiences to the biggest names in the Conservative Movement through their leading campus lecture program. YAF speakers are the most inspiring conservative voices in America, including **Arthur Laffer, Katie Pavlich,** YAF’s Ronald Reagan Presidential Scholar and Vice President **Mike Pence, Dinesh D’Souza, Lila Rose, Steve Forbes,** Lt. Col.**Allen West** , Speaker**Newt Gingrich, Michael Knowles, Dana Loesch, James O’Keefe,** NFL star and Congressman **Burgess Owens, Star Parker,** Fox News’s**Jesse Watters,** and many others.
* YAF teaches **_millions of students_ **across the nation YOUR conservative values through breakthrough conferences, training seminars, and campus activism initiatives and activities. (In fact, YAF is the only Conservative Movement organization that has a full suite of conservative educational programs for high school students!)
* And YAF preserves and protects President Reagan’s ranch in Santa Barbara, California and Boyhood Home in Dixon, Illinois. They saved these national treasures so young people can learn about Ronald Reagan’s lasting accomplishments.

_No other organization reaches conservative students with foundational American ideas on a bigger scale than Young America’s Foundation._ _That’s why I prefer YAF to be my sole sponsor for campus events._ They fight for the right to ensure alternative voices are heard on college campuses. They stop campuses from being turned into Leftist echo chambers. I am glad I have YAF on my side and the side of the students. But YAF can’t do this alone. As the Left continues to stoop to desperate new lows to silence conservatives, it’s become more important than ever that our values are shared with the next generation of thought leaders. We both know that the Left doesn’t want a fair discussion of ideas. But that’s why YAF needs your help today. At any moment, a scheduled event could get shut down by campus radicals or administrators, and the YAF team must be ready to engage them on a moment’s notice. [**Will you contribute $35 or more today so that YAF’s rapid response team will always be ready to leap into action the next time leftists decide to shut down free speech and deprive students of the chance to hear your conservative ideas?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z43t9vnovn2oebvi2ultlhf6nj955u2gclebegqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs) Friend, a donation of $35 or whatever you choose does more than you know. The impact amplifying conservative voices will have on the future of our country can’t be overstated. I cannot encourage you enough to consider giving to YAF today. Partnering with YAF today is our opportunity to win a generation that values freedom. I can’t think of a better investment. Ronald Reagan stated, “There is no better way to establish hope for the future than to enlighten young minds.” I look forward to hearing back from you. -Ben Ben Shapiro [**Will you support Young America’s Foundation with a contribution of $35, $50, $100, or even $1000 today, to save this generation by presenting conservative ideas to students across the country?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zao4395arurpc9k26kbirgfs32vg6bgqo1p3f7ug_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs) [**DONATE**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd4j7davqcs8mesvukmqf77anqo8lscp12u9bfl8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs) [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk3mjlp59b3ddhchccnj0jq0rg7pe7m5smjai0t8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs) | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1brlfo2ra6adtacuate3t8p8n82fdimocmjqn00_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs) | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zev38gbm5924vrdd87ambm5ct7f8phc03t9vm3eg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs) | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsklua8i7kmmrb7qse7risvob712bt5bqf05olko_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctgm2o70s1h2bs)

name: American Update
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9926%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=RX9zTKa9dlzNrr7nHMjYHA&sysid=1)

This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. name: Ben Shapiro
subject: 9 Antifa Leftists arrested
body:
Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6960%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=3STOdGExiRP9zAoNzIYjfg&sysid=1)
Fellow Patriot, Insidious leftist ideology has taken hold of our educational system. It’s never been more important that we expose it, because the Left has lit an ideological fire, and that fire is now consuming the minds of young Americans, burning itself through the most aspects of American culture and politics. That’s why it’s of utmost importance that I hear back from you today. I’m no stranger to the authoritarian attitudes on campus; I famously felt the brunt of it when conservative students invited me to speak on the University of California, Berkeley campus. [**HELP US FIGHT THE RADICAL LEFT**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61786%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=F3HQjUP2dzV0BQM%2btb4quA&sysid=1) Radical leftist groups like Antifa vowed to riot and cause harm to others. The fear of violence from leftist agitators was so great that:
* It cost $600,000 in security expenses and required hundreds of policemen to ensure that agitators didn’t disrupt or try to cause violence at my speech.
* The University shut down six buildings on campus during my speech and erected concrete barricades (YES, a wall) to secure the Berkeley campus.
* For the first time in 20 years, the City of Berkeley voted to allow the use of pepper spray against violent protesters.
* In the end, police arrested nine leftists for trying to sneak banned weapons into our event--with the likely intent to do harm.

It’s no longer just about the Left trying to suppress your conservative views on campus. It’s about using the threat of violence to silence the conservative values you and I share. Meanwhile, schools roll out the red carpet for leftists like Angela Davis, Bill Ayers, Barack Obama, Bill Clinton, and Bernie Sanders. At Berkeley, taxpayer-funded school administrators tried to derail my event from even taking place. They told me that they didn’t have a lecture hall available, which was a lie. School administrators even cut the venue in half by not allowing students to sit in the balcony--a dirty tactic to minimize attendance. _**The good news is the radical Left’s attempts to silence me completely backfired.**_**** More than 600 students showed up, and we were able to host an engaging and civil event. Then, OVER 10 MILLION PEOPLE watched my speech online (that’s more viewers than any of the major evening newscasts). This victory for the Conservative Movement would have never happened if it weren’t for the **Young America’s Foundation** **(YAF)**. When Berkeley tried to illegally block me from coming to campus, YAF sued the university --**and won.** But the radicals who rioted and tried to incite violence at Berkeley are relentless. Their stranglehold on America’s universities has not yet been broken. **Young America’s Foundation** has been an incredible partner in making sure I am able to share our conservative values with students on campuses across the country. In fact, I speak on campuses **_exclusively_** through YAF because I know YAF has the experience and leadership necessary to run the nation’s leading campus lecture program. Today YAF needs your help. **[Will you contribute $35 today to ensure that YAF can continue to present speakers, including Dr. Arthur Laffer, Katie Pavlich, Senator Ted Cruz, and many others to high school and college students? Without you, the mission to pass along our conservative values to future generations will stall out.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61787%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iybqHOpOFPPX%2fmt2Rc6jNw&sysid=1)** Let me tell you a little bit more about what YAF does to advance conservative ideas. Speaking to an audience of Young America’s Foundation students, Vice President Mike Pence noted, “Since its founding in 1960, YAF has been a bulwark of American greatness.” YAF valiantly defends the values we share by educating impressionable young people who have been ideologically poisoned by leftist propaganda for decades, by the very teachers and professors they’re told to trust. YAF’s team is the best at what they do. They are _**#1: the LARGEST and MOST effective conservative youth outreach organization in America**._ Here’s why:
* YAF introduces young audiences to the biggest names in the Conservative Movement through their leading campus lecture program. YAF speakers are the most inspiring conservative voices in America, including **Arthur Laffer, Katie Pavlich,** YAF’s Ronald Reagan Presidential Scholar and Vice President **Mike Pence, Dinesh D’Souza, Lila Rose, Steve Forbes,** Lt. Col.**Allen West** , Speaker**Newt Gingrich, Michael Knowles, Dana Loesch, James O’Keefe,** NFL star and Congressman **Burgess Owens, Star Parker,** Fox News’s**Jesse Watters,** and many others.
* YAF teaches **_millions of students_ **across the nation YOUR conservative values through breakthrough conferences, training seminars, and campus activism initiatives and activities. (In fact, YAF is the only Conservative Movement organization that has a full suite of conservative educational programs for high school students!)
* And YAF preserves and protects President Reagan’s ranch in Santa Barbara, California and Boyhood Home in Dixon, Illinois. They saved these national treasures so young people can learn about Ronald Reagan’s lasting accomplishments.

_No other organization reaches conservative students with foundational American ideas on a bigger scale than Young America’s Foundation._ _That’s why I prefer YAF to be my sole sponsor for campus events._ They fight for the right to ensure alternative voices are heard on college campuses. They stop campuses from being turned into Leftist echo chambers. I am glad I have YAF on my side and the side of the students. But YAF can’t do this alone. As the Left continues to stoop to desperate new lows to silence conservatives, it’s become more important than ever that our values are shared with the next generation of thought leaders. We both know that the Left doesn’t want a fair discussion of ideas. But that’s why YAF needs your help today. At any moment, a scheduled event could get shut down by campus radicals or administrators, and the YAF team must be ready to engage them on a moment’s notice. [**Will you contribute $35 or more today so that YAF’s rapid response team will always be ready to leap into action the next time leftists decide to shut down free speech and deprive students of the chance to hear your conservative ideas?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61788%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oKGhawGa5DOlqjY%2bu4IMIA&sysid=1) Friend, a donation of $35 or whatever you choose does more than you know. The impact amplifying conservative voices will have on the future of our country can’t be overstated. I cannot encourage you enough to consider giving to YAF today. Partnering with YAF today is our opportunity to win a generation that values freedom. I can’t think of a better investment. Ronald Reagan stated, “There is no better way to establish hope for the future than to enlighten young minds.” I look forward to hearing back from you. -Ben Ben Shapiro [**Will you support Young America’s Foundation with a contribution of $35, $50, $100, or even $1000 today, to save this generation by presenting conservative ideas to students across the country?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61789%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CSEWqwAYHD2EUN4FcyDOUA&sysid=1) [**DONATE**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61780%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CGXn5yW46cdvpUBOAwV%2fIQ&sysid=1) [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61781%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XmqN%2f%2f7EeP7Fbcp0%2fP4h0w&sysid=1) | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61782%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XGFkGYDcde%2b9bJm05IP%2f%2bg&sysid=1) | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61783%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qyfYK9WtjDVMEh0njkelNg&sysid=1) | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61784%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rx3v%2bpNwvlWSl4XSpGxYdg&sysid=1)

_**" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Peter,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_" Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Peter, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." _
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

| In 1997, not many people thought a young Black state senator from Illinois named Barack Obama could one day become president. And even once he won the election, many folks doubted he could actually get such a bold agenda done. In that same year, I was a high school social studies teacher and never could have imagined that, just three generations after my family was enslaved, I would become the U.S. Secretary of Education under the first Black president in our nation’s history. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44940112/343790660/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220505-b1_fr_nd-JK_S1_C1&&&&refcode=email-ngp-20220505-b1_fr_nd-JK_S1_C1&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&utm_source=ngp&&&&utm_campaign=20220505&&&&utm_content=b1_fr_nd&&&&utm_term=JK_S1_C1&&&&amount=25&refcode2=83adc780-77cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4M2FkYzc4MC03N2NjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7qoj4CVV1-7-cRWb60HgKnEZEMnNmnac710B6n4tV8I=) It’s humbling to be a part of history. President Obama always said that history is like a relay race — you can’t accomplish everything in your lifetime, you have to receive the baton from your predecessor and pass it on to the next person. Whether as a teacher, principal, advocate, or U.S. Secretary of Education, I have used my position to close opportunity gaps and create a more equitable society. clean_body: Not many people thought a young Black state senator from Illinois named Barack Obama could one day become president. | = | In 1997, not many people thought a young Black state senator from Illinois named Barack Obama could one day become president. And even once he won the election, many folks doubted he could actually get such a bold agenda done. In that same year, I was a high school social studies teacher and never could have imagined that, just three generations after my family was enslaved, I would become the U.S. Secretary of Education under the first Black president in our nation’s history. = It’s humbling to be a part of history. President Obama always said that history is like a relay race — you can’t accomplish everything in your lifetime, you have to receive the baton from your predecessor and pass it on to the next person. Whether as a teacher, principal, advocate, or U.S. Secretary of Education, I have used my position to close opportunity gaps and create a more equitable society. And as the next Governor of Maryland, I will continue to do so — but I need to know I have you with me. Real change can only be made possible by a strong grassroots movement. If you believe that together we can improve things for the better, = With any sized donation that you give today, you will be lighting the way for myself and our movement to continue all the way to Annapolis, where we can make historic strides with policies on economic dignity, education reform, and more to benefit all Marylanders. | | |

I have a rare 15-minute gap in my schedule today, friend. I know it doesn't sound like a lot, but free moments have been few and far between recently.
As I sit here drinking my coffee, I'm reflecting on this historic campaign – and I decided I need to tell you a story about why I'm running for U.S. Senate.
When I was a little girl, my family didn't have much. I grew up as one of seven siblings, living in a two-room house in Jacksonville, Florida. I went to segregated schools and worked wherever I could – washing dishes or flipping burgers at McDonald's – to help my family get by.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44944722/343809851/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3088-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODE5OWU2My03Y2NjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=i5Vjsr9v0eyZ0LqpBzPG9ftJNITwjk-NTyvVp7lsZd8=)
My grandma lived just down the street from my family. She grew up in the Jim Crow South, and she couldn't read or write, so she made an "X" for all her signatures. As a kid, I remember sitting at my grandma's kitchen table writing letters to her sister as she told me what to say.
I can't help but think about what my grandma would say if she could see the life I lead now. She never could have imagined that I would grow up to become Orlando's Chief of Police, a congressional representative for my home district and a candidate for the U.S. Senate.
Now, I have a chance to deliver better leadership to the people of Florida – and I promise to fight every day to expand opportunities for families like mine. If you believe in my campaign, will you contribute today?
**[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44944723/343809871/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3088-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODE5OWU2My03Y2NjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=i5Vjsr9v0eyZ0LqpBzPG9ftJNITwjk-NTyvVp7lsZd8=)**
I truly believe that only in America can a little Black girl – the granddaughter of a woman robbed of the chance to learn to read – have such an amazing story of opportunity like mine.
But for too many Americans, my story of opportunity is simply out of reach. I'm running for U.S. Senate to expand opportunities for working families like mine – so that everyone can have a fair chance to reach their own American dream.
My 15 minutes are almost up, so I'll wrap this up with one final thought: This is a historic campaign – and the GOP is trying to stack the cards against me because Marco Rubio and I are neck and neck in the polls. If you believe in this movement to expand opportunities for all Americans, I need you on my side right now.
My finance team told me we need more grassroots donations to win, so I have to ask this: Will you donate $5 right now to help me defeat Marco Rubio and protect our Senate majority?

Here's the best link to give: **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44944724/343809875/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3088-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODE5OWU2My03Y2NjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=i5Vjsr9v0eyZ0LqpBzPG9ftJNITwjk-NTyvVp7lsZd8=)**

Thank you for reading my story,

Congresswoman Val Demings

name: Data and Communication Manager
subject: Reminder - Candidate debate 6 pm at Whiteside Theater on May 5th - tonight!
body:
Join us tonight, Thursday May 5th at 6 pm in downtown Corvallis for a Town Hall Debate!

Seven of the nine candidates for Peter DeFazio’s District 4 seat in Congress plan to be at the Whiteside Theatre! This is a free nonpartisan event co-sponsored by ASOSU and the League of Women Voters of Corvallis. Bring your questions for the candidates!

What: US Congress Oregon District 4 Candidate Debate!
When: Thursday May 5th at 6 pm
Where: Whiteside Theatre (4th and Madison in downtown Corvallis)

Bring your questions for the candidates: Sami Al-Abdrabbuh, Doyle Canning, Andrew Kalloch, Jake Matthews, Steve Laible, John Selker and Tommy Smith. The other candidates were also invited but are not attending.

Robyn Davis, Albany Human Relations Commissioner, will moderate the live debate.

Here is the zoom link for the debate:

**Topic:** OR 4th Congressional District Primary Candidates' Forum
**Time:** May 5, 2022 06:00 PM Pacific Time (US and Canada)
**Join Zoom Meeting:** [https://oregonstate.zoom.us/j/99597912123?pwd=bGNUQ25XWHlTSDJnZlhnbEhTY3Fadz09](https://oregonstate.zoom.us/j/99597912123?pwd=bGNUQ25XWHlTSDJnZlhnbEhTY3Fadz09)

body:
[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6963%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=DnwVmtdN6lEb8N8xDE3qkA&sysid=1)
Dear Fellow Defender of Life,
Is Roe going to be overturned? The leaked draft _Dobbs_ Supreme Court decision ROCKED America... ...showing a majority possibly deciding to end the egregiously wrong decision that has resulted in 62 million dead. But as Justice Alito wrote, if this decision is actually handed down, lawmakers must act or the slaughter will simply continue: “We hold that Roe and Casey must be overruled. It is time to heed the Constitution and return the issue of abortion to the people’s elected representatives.” _Overturning Roe will save no babies. State legislatures MUST act in order to end abortion_. And we’re already working to do just that! In fact, that’s why Action for Life exists! No other national organization is already working to end abortion where they MUST be ended, in the states. We already have bills up in 13 states, including in Louisiana where we have a bill that just WON in committee YESTERDAY and is headed for the House floor for a full vote! _AFL Vice President Zach Lautenschlager testifies in committee in Louisiana yesterday in for HB 813 to end abortion statewide.The bill passed committee and is headed for the floor._ [Would you please join us in actually ending abortion?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61793%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eCG7DEpNd4QfHI0TqXHTig&sysid=1) I can’t tell you how important this is. You see, even with Roe on the chopping block, babies will go right on dying.Even once Roe is actually overturned, **_babies will go right on dying_.** That’s because the law has not actually changed. Abortion is “legal” in America because the laws allow it. _Unless we act to change those laws, Roe changes NOTHING_. And you can be sure that Planned Parenthood and the rest of the pro-abortion forces are going to fiercly fight us every step of the way. In fact, Planned Parenthood vassals like Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-VT) and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-NY) are already clamoring to codify Roe by passing it both in Congress and in state legislatures. They are gearing up for one of the biggest political fights in American history, sweeping through every state capitol and wracking the halls of Congress. [We need your help!](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61794%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EMDz4DJd8KpdL8SSiTQd2g&sysid=1) This is going to be one of the most expensive political battles America has seen. Planned Parenthood is already spending millions, and they have BILLIONS more (yes, with a “B”) to spend. As horrifying as it is, the abortion industry is raking in billions of dollars every year by killing tiny children in the womb. And they are going to fight with everything they have to keep it that way. _This is why we can’t win without your help_! Action for Life is the leading national organization working to end abortion. Our team has successfully passed legislation in dozens of states. They are experts, but they need your support! [Would you join with us today by making a donation to support banning abortion?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61705%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nJFHSHrYTVA96bzYCZ9cBQ&sysid=1) We MUST take action. Perhaps you could donate $100 or $75 today. Or perhaps $50 or $35 is closer to what you could do. Even $25, $15 or $10 will help us advance bills in the states and in Congress. [Please take action NOW!](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61706%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CACIoE4jplutTPM8PuaFJA&sysid=1) Thank you, in advance. Dennis Sarfate
President
_Action for Life_ P.S. With Roe on the chopping block, we need your help more than ever! _Until the states act to end abortion, the killing will continue even if Roe is fully overturned_. The leaked Dobbs draft decision, showing a majority of the Supreme Court Justices voting to fully overturn, gives great hope. But without your action today, NOTHING will change. Not one single baby will be saved until the states make abortion illegal. _Our team is working in Louisiana on our bill to ban abortion. We have similar legislation in 14 other states_! [But we can’t advance without your help.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61707%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fjMaNXCyy%2fg5jMpB6NIIZw&sysid=1) Would you consider a generous contribution of $100 or $75? Or perhaps you could donate $50 or $35 today. Maybe $25, $15 or $10 is more like it. Whatever you can do, please [take action](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61708%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PHwFVjFM6NvpFlZmAN9uIw&sysid=1) today! We CAN end abortion, and with your help, that’s exactly what we’re going to do.

* * *
Action for Life

This past weekend the [Republican Party of Virginia](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018YezRytp9PEmvsIcwVW4Xj3aloktTECP3jHqaxQmMAM7KJx5KxCkQK2sqrm0wQzCMAOGJks14LICXkoFD6r7iZ1JRQw3llbC_x6yCkhuYiMQ7sZsS2TdTKgzWnLdoWwWbP_JcAyDXrw=&c=_MBYMDuW1r5gsISmk5rE0Ae3YU_Fqyi4_1m9IB1YtA2zcPnCzzxRsg==&ch=sgzZsLIBX5PwFFUd1OX5a17nhw_Qo_RPPFEbKEzTc3Zy5Dh_LtKN7w==) held their annual statewide gathering, The Advance (Republicans never retreat!) in Herndon. One of the breakout sessions I attended was on the importance of religious freedom and the participants included religious leaders from the Christian, Jewish, Hindu and Muslim communities.

One of the panel's participants was my grandfather, former Congressman Frank Wolf, who has been an international leader and fighter for human and religious rights, [written a book](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018YezRytp9PEmvsIcwVW4Xj3aloktTECP3jHqaxQmMAM7KJx5KxCkQB53WZw7KbxLQ9jksSQ5Rw6Bzn95_aBeHQhN9Ck9pUsZ4H4JjEiPH9RF29p54CPSFaoHyIYupd09nsTGI-3DPnYRrtWu1BnEqvXq50oQWea1-z7FHXEyJ-jMn1XDXEgDvd7qPTz7kZYOMvZhgxtOonrrnryex1Gtt0ipXbiSbmDk&c=_MBYMDuW1r5gsISmk5rE0Ae3YU_Fqyi4_1m9IB1YtA2zcPnCzzxRsg==&ch=sgzZsLIBX5PwFFUd1OX5a17nhw_Qo_RPPFEbKEzTc3Zy5Dh_LtKN7w==) on this important subject and was honored in 2016 with a law named "[The Frank R. Wolf Religious Freedom Act](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018YezRytp9PEmvsIcwVW4Xj3aloktTECP3jHqaxQmMAM7KJx5KxCkQOdwArHBvYeqrm3o8u3J_NSPoD_10xcwCA_X8F9DZyrBolJhD78UUepePC-9f4yfUK9hr5ZZ-0DMmX7Z6tYBY2uOV8t8o87RHE23iHzx4ht2AU406bDX3jJe4K9_C2uzz9HBrrPfASsN&c=_MBYMDuW1r5gsISmk5rE0Ae3YU_Fqyi4_1m9IB1YtA2zcPnCzzxRsg==&ch=sgzZsLIBX5PwFFUd1OX5a17nhw_Qo_RPPFEbKEzTc3Zy5Dh_LtKN7w==)".

Over the last month, we have celebrated across the 10th District, Easter, Passover and Ramadan. I was privileged to be able to attend services at many of our houses of worship and spoke with dedicated followers of many faiths. Our country was founded on the right to freely practice your faith while many across the world are persecuted, and in places like China, imprisoned or face death, for their beliefs. (Please see below my work as Co-Founder of the [Athenai Institute](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018YezRytp9PEmvsIcwVW4Xj3aloktTECP3jHqaxQmMAM7KJx5KxCkQG55WvGySEsPygKLH5ucjJKFByuH7TpbNcFkF3KEJuzS2pEhSJd_HURHxqCTbr7rtQd6tIT9N_R-uo8AiwOFU3E=&c=_MBYMDuW1r5gsISmk5rE0Ae3YU_Fqyi4_1m9IB1YtA2zcPnCzzxRsg==&ch=sgzZsLIBX5PwFFUd1OX5a17nhw_Qo_RPPFEbKEzTc3Zy5Dh_LtKN7w==) to have our universities divest from China's human rights abuses).

Our churches, mosques and synagogues are the cornerstones of our communities. From the beginning of my campaign, i have focused on Country, Community and Common Sense.

As your representative in Washington, I promise to continue the fight for every individual's right to religious freedom and their ability to worship.

The security and integrity of Florida’s elections has been a top priority of mine since day one of being elected Governor, Peter.

Unsolicited ballots, weak voter ID laws, and taking days (even weeks) to count votes does NOT inspire confidence among voters. We made sure this was not the status quo in the Sunshine State.

When COVID hit, we didn’t unconstitutionally change procedures. We followed the law. And in 2020, we didn’t wait to count votes. We counted 99% of them by midnight on Election Day.

There are many facets to election security which is why earlier this year, I signed legislation increasing penalties for ballot harvesting, expanding our ban on "Zuckerbucks," and establishing an election integrity unit in state government to enforce Florida law.

Florida has and will continue to lead the nation on election security as long as I am Governor, but I can’t do it alone. Are you with me?

| | | **Oldsmar Mayor Dan Saracki Endorses
Amanda Makki!**
Hi Friend!

We have some very exciting news! Last week we told you about the changes to the congressional district maps. FL 13 now includes the city of Oldsmar and it’s Mayor, Dan Saracki, just announced he is endorsing the most qualified and the only Community Conservative in this race, Amanda Makki!

Amanda now has the support of 11 Pinellas County Mayors! It is clear that there is a consensus by leaders across CD 13 that Amanda Makki is the best candidate to represent the people, values, and issues that matter to residents here.

As the Community Conservative, she spends her time working and meeting with the people of Pinellas County earning the respect of officials like Mayor Saracki.

**"I'm proud to join 10 other Mayors who have endorsed Amanda Makki, the only Community Conservative in the race for the new CD 13 seat," said Mayor Dan Saracki. "We have a fighter in Rep. Bilirakis and****** Amanda will continue to lead and be a champion for our veterans, small business owners, and every one of us who is struggling with the skyrocketing costs of food and fuel!"

Amanda thanked Mayor Saracki for his support.

**“I have the highest regard for Oldsmar Mayor Dan Saracki and I am extremely grateful for his support in this race,” said Amanda Makki. “I am ecstatic about Oldsmar now being in FL-13, and as the Community Conservative, I will continue to lead in Congressman Bilirakis’ footsteps by working hard to ensure the highest level of constituent services for the residents of this great community.”**

This endorsement adds to the incredible momentum in Amanda Makki's campaign. There has never been a more exciting time to get involved! Here are some ways you can support Amanda.
* [Join Team Makki as a volunteer!](mailto:Skylar@amandamakki.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20join%20Team%20Makki%20as%20a%20volunteer!)
* [RSVP for one of Amanda's upcoming events](https://amandamakki.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e08b08a89872d093efe5d84d&id=c8af2b2899&e=c2296cffff)
* [Make a contribution to support Amanda's efforts](https://amandamakki.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e08b08a89872d093efe5d84d&id=d29bdd479d&e=c2296cffff)

See you on campaign trail!

Team Makki
P. S. If you’d like to host a meet and greet for Amanda, please e-mail Nancy@amandamakki.com

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Young
people today grow up being told that their perception of reality
is a matter of perspective. Recently, they are even told that
women can choose to be men and men women.

This
denial of objective reality-including a denial of an objective
good-is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and
of free government.

Largely
as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is
releasing its latest free online course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity."

Taught by
Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a
professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture
course covers Lewis's philosophical defense of an objective good
and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity.

I am
writing today to ask if you would consider pre-registering for
this free online course. You can do so at this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60095838:WzUNmgH0N:m:3:2532013465:58D581E219DC1EDF11E12B623C326285:r

After
pre-registering for "C.S. Lewis on Christianity," please help us
meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on May 16 to
promote this new online course effectively, especially to young
people.

Hillsdale
produces its free online courses, as it does all its work, while
refusing to accept government funding-not even indirectly in the
form of federal or state student grants or loans. We are entirely
dependent on private donations.

With your
tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of
young people in this new free online course and expand
Hillsdale's other outreach efforts.

Thank you
for your friendship and support.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

This denial of objective reality—including a denial of an objective good—is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and of free government. Largely as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is releasing its latest free online course,“C.S. Lewis on Christianity.” Taught by Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture course covers Lewis’s philosophical defense of an objective good and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity. We are entirely dependent on private donations. [**What is in the documentary?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44959425/343851523/-331372331?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzQ1MjdjOS05NGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vj4Q2TuHAObebPBNEoFcj8DVVjJzfrTq-FBL5np83Qw=&emci=f1c499a7-92cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b74527c9-94cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) ASOG conducted a rash audit of Antrim County's Dominion voting machines, falsely concluding intentional election fraud. In the documentary, J. Alex Halderman, one of the country's most prominent experts on voting systems, said the report was full of "obvious errors and false claims." Yet, Bergman and others used the faulty evidence to ignite and fuel the Big Lie across the country. Halderman says the report was "grasping at straws and just trying to find anything that might be used to spin a narrative about fraud." He says "the public's trust has been greatly undermined." [**How is Bergman connected?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44959426/343851524/-331372331?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzQ1MjdjOS05NGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vj4Q2TuHAObebPBNEoFcj8DVVjJzfrTq-FBL5np83Qw=&emci=f1c499a7-92cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b74527c9-94cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) Just before the documentary aired, an [exposé report by the Record Eagle](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44959427/343851525/-2137054058?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzQ1MjdjOS05NGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vj4Q2TuHAObebPBNEoFcj8DVVjJzfrTq-FBL5np83Qw=&emci=f1c499a7-92cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b74527c9-94cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) discovered that Jack Bergman coordinated with ASOG in December 2020 to schedule the audit. Bergman was involved with the controversial Dallas-based group, catching Republican officials off-guard. Dr. Lorinser says the documentary shows what triggered a nationwide conspiracy theory that ignited the Jan. 6 insurrection. "'Plot to Overturn the Election' shows the faulty audit with which Jack Bergman interfered," said Dr. Lorinser. "Knowing full well the results in Antrim were caused by an honest mistake in a Republican clerk's office, my opponent doubled-down on election conspiracy theories. He clearly knew fraud did not exist, and still used ASOG's error-ridden report to spread lies and justify his attempt to de-certify the election." [**What does the exposé include?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44959428/343851526/-331372331?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzQ1MjdjOS05NGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vj4Q2TuHAObebPBNEoFcj8DVVjJzfrTq-FBL5np83Qw=&emci=f1c499a7-92cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b74527c9-94cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427)

According to the Record Eagle, Bergman's assistance to ASOG mystified local Republican election officials. [THE RECORD EAGLE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44959430/343851528/-2137054058?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzQ1MjdjOS05NGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vj4Q2TuHAObebPBNEoFcj8DVVjJzfrTq-FBL5np83Qw=&emci=f1c499a7-92cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b74527c9-94cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) _**"A congressman from Michigan, in December 2020, helped coordinate county officials and out-of-state political operatives who were granted access to examine Dominion voting machines in Antrim County.**_ _**"Jack Bergman, a third-term Republican congressman representing Michigan’s First District, was not on site for the court-ordered exam, records show, but he exchanged calls with county officials to arrange the arrival time of the Allied Security Operations Group team.**_ _**"Bergman’s calls are referenced in internal emails the county prosecutor’s office released in response to a Freedom of Information Act request filed by the Record-Eagle.**_ _**"Ed Boettcher, a Republican who in 2020 chaired the county’s Board of Commissioners said he had two conversations with Bergman, a one-on-one and a conference call.**_ _**"'I have no insight as to why,' Boettcher said, of Bergman’s involvement. 'I had that question in my mind — ‘You’re not a plaintiff, you’re not an attorney, why are you involved?’ — and I didn’t have any answers.'**_ _**"On Jan. 6, 2021, Bergman objected to Electoral College votes in Arizona and Pennsylvania, citing what he called in a statement posted on his official congressional website, irregularities, fraud, and failure to follow election laws."**_ [**What does Doc think?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44959431/343851529/-331372331?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzQ1MjdjOS05NGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vj4Q2TuHAObebPBNEoFcj8DVVjJzfrTq-FBL5np83Qw=&emci=f1c499a7-92cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b74527c9-94cc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) **"We now know that my opponent was more than just part of the Big Lie," said Dr. Lorinser. "He was the sole member of Congress responsible for igniting it nationwide from ground-zero in Antrim County."** Dr. Lorinser calls Bergman's actions "disturbing, shocking, and worthy of further investigation", claiming the Representative's involvement threatens the principles upon which this nation was born. Lorinser also says just as disturbing is Bergman's staffer claiming the challenges in Antrim county were not political or partisan. "The voters of the 1st District demand accountability and an explanation directly from our Congressperson why he was involved at all," said Dr. Lorinser. "As indicated by sources in the investigative report, my opponent's behavior here is highly unusual, suspicious, and clearly partisan-motivated. This was not only shameful and dishonest; it was a real threat to the country. **"Doubling down on a lie is not strength. It's dishonorable." —Dr. Lorinser.** "It's time to end the dishonesty, tales of falsehoods, and outright lies," said Dr. Lorinser. "We must return to a 'government of the people, by the people, for the people.' We need honesty in Congress, and I look forward to the opportunity to bring dignity and integrity back to this office for Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula."

Dear Peter,
With the Supreme Court expected to overturn Roe v. Wade within the next two months, we must move with urgent and deliberative speed to preserve the reproductive rights and freedom of women in Maryland. That’s why I am urging Governor Larry Hogan to immediately release the $3.5 million restricted in the Fiscal Year 2023 operating budget to provide funding for abortion care training programs.
The end of Roe v. Wade will lead to the outlawing of abortion in 26 states, including nearby states like West Virginia, Ohio, Tennessee, and Kentucky. We can expect demand for abortion care to dramatically increase as a result, and I believe that Maryland should be prepared to step up and provide these critical healthcare services to women who need them.
There is no question of affordability here – with more than $200 million left in our State’s General Fund, we are well-positioned to deploy these funds now before the anticipated overruling of Roe.
I am unapologetically pro-choice. If I’m blessed to be Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll vocally oppose any attempts to restrict reproductive rights, and I’ll fight to protect and expand abortion care in Maryland. It is not enough to preserve the status quo – we must push back against these attacks on the right to choose with bold policy action, including:

subject: Standing up for life
body:

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ce187c43e13c4a87a487affbedd62187&_e=-2FtwUKCtLBERU6SPClXit4C_2b4kuR9bj2JUblrhEqTXWJdQ_nFLjkIssPRyhpwFyX3ivrsxVIK3-_UcaiXz8Fn5MUKnkPX-nyOQi2DfdgiB_ZSwyWiDw2YJ5RM6ZmvU6EBtk75Mssjv7pwoq_GqrDlIJQ3c8_XhqtH7gwTougGXCpgLYIXAyTWXMZ34slCstXd2L0h5IT9ZWTQ9H8NwsXKERDVeYvxfCitX9jNJs7ourU5EEjljw9a6yDz-BOBjXi3_20NAfHRHPXElAZVqew18t99SK674WOl5Fw2kMWm40apmrv1XXFn9hr8xrBejJToXFAP7zIBrvj89FwA8OKZ3y0uQ873uzR3Nzahe1xntvUmCoELFFH1RGjCxt1jS6J4DsNQVbYfweX-uC6zBzOBi1nuL0yd0Xt_JgmxXpreWK7icgzCkeof_m8T7Ck3)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ce187c43e13c4a87a487affbedd62187&_e=-2FtwUKCtLBERU6SPClXit4C_2b4kuR9bj2JUblrhEqTXWJdQ_nFLjkIssPRyhpwFyX3ivrsxVIK3-_UcaiXz8Fn5MUKnkPX-nyOQi2DfdgiB_ZSwyWiDw2YJ5RM6ZmvU6EBtk75Mssjv7pwoq_GqrDlIJQ3c8_XhqtH7gwTougGXCpgLYIXAyTWXMZ34slCstXd2L0h5IT9ZWTQ9H8Nwj92fpXVaKIRGgz4vBFFyIksyPCM-g-R0CMA72SBc69ExpY8ALnB9Gh3e5TBrtD_NY8YvBgSCW0XRYWhhlmjKmW4GZVgg-e61WqHnikYfVb1JlAqMVyMLhQOXozfSRDxSgERbDQbKVae39No0-rOU657Lb_ePusGmbqUtWFKIoFlqWsDSDHskrN2lfxvcLOoFSzjKTNGjdP00QBJOD5XX4BCP3DcwW64rHxxs8HcCxub) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? | Vernon Jones Slams Lack of Transparency in Rivian Debacle
---
|
---
| Madison, GA (May 5, 2022)- Vernon Jones strongly condemns lack of transparency in shady Rivian deal, worth $1.5 billion of taxpayer funds.
"This entire process has been a slap in the face to rural Georgians who were not asked about building the Rivian plant in their backyards. There are more than enough places better suited and developed for the Rivian plant than Morgan and Walton county. Additionally, there has been no answer from anyone about the potential safety and environmental concerns. There has been zero accountability in the entire process, and I can't tell if they're incompetent or if it's a conspiracy. Unfortunately, this fits with the trend of Georgia's pitiful leadership subsidizing Globalist raiders like Hollywood and George Soros to plunder and subvert our state."
"Until the people of Walton and Morgan county are convinced the project should happen (they're not), I am not convinced and will do all that I can to stop it. I have been one of the only candidates running for Congressional District 10 to show up to these county meetings and ask the tough questions. I will continue to show up and fight and expose how our state is fleecing Georgians."

---
| About Vernon Jones
---
| Vernon Jones is running for Georgia's 10th Congressional District. He is a former member of the GA House of Representatives (1993-2001, 2017-2021) and former Chief Executive Officer of DeKalb County, GA. A former Democrat, Jones officially switched parties in January 2021 after endorsing Donald J. Trump for President and speaking at the 2020 Republican National Convention. The proud Republican is now running in GA10, as a Pro-Trump candidate who will fight for free and fair elections, and always put Georgia and America First.

body:
Peter,

In the wake of COVID-19, Working Families put together The People’s Charter, a series of policy ideas and value statements that all progressives should get behind.

I support all of these — but Rep. Donald Payne Jr. can’t say the same. And once we look at some of the key policies here, it will be clear that I’m the ONLY progressive in this race.

Let’s take a look at just a few of these:

“Shift resources away from policing, jails and detention centers, [and] endless wars”
Payne Jr.: Supports military aid to Israel and takes money from weapons manufacturers
Imani: Calls for justice in Palestine and an end to endless wars

“Tax the giant corporations who don’t pay their share.”
Payne Jr.: Takes money from giant corporations including ExxonMobil, Amazon, Merck, Johnson & Johnson, Wells Fargo, Enbridge, and more.
Imani: Refuses to take a single cent from corporate PACs.

“Invest now to make our food, water, electricity, health, financial and other systems resilient to future crises like climate change.”
Payne Jr.: Refuses to sign on to the Green New Deal or the No Fossil Fuel Money pledge.
Imani: Recognized as a Green New Deal Champion ( Check it out! [https://gndchampions.com/champions/] )

We know Payne Jr. has taken money from the worst actors. We know that I’m fighting for JUSTICE and running a people-powered campaign.

Want a real progressive in Washington? There’s only ONE in this race, and it’s not Donald Payne Jr. Click here to chip in $27 and support our progressive movement. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e-io-may-2022?refcode=505wfp]

Thank you for standing with me.

— Imani

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44962302/343856851/390307162?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDAyMzdlYy05NmNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bMtmCTbjSxG-Dh1RSHeinp8DLclZ2eU2DBmbD7bdm1U=)
Friend,

Yesterday I took part in a pro-reproductive rights rally in front of Chico City Hall. If you read the _Chico Enterprise-Record_ , you’ll see me holding a sign on the front page picture. I also got a lot of pictures with supporters, many of whom were Chico State students afraid that they would soon lose the right to control their own body. Here’s a picture of me with a few of them.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44962303/343856852/-96927706?refcode=em-5.4.22-all-a&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDAyMzdlYy05NmNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bMtmCTbjSxG-Dh1RSHeinp8DLclZ2eU2DBmbD7bdm1U=)
While I was at the protest, Rep. LaMalfa was crafting a press release that defended the Supreme Court decision to deny women choice over their own bodies. Unfortunately, protests will probably not be enough to protect our constitutional rights. The Republican Supreme Court does not care what the people of America think anymore than they care about judicial precedent. They are unaccountable ideologues.

Instead, we need to fight for our rights at the ballot box. Our long-term goals should be a Constitutional Amendment codifying an explicit right to privacy, in addition to a less partisan Supreme Court.

But that doesn’t mean that we should give up the short-game.

Here’s an idea:

In Congress, I would sponsor legislation prohibiting the Department of Defense from stationing personnel in states that restrict access to abortion before viability.

If Texas, or Georgia, or Florida want to outlaw abortions, then the military should close every single base in those states and move those personnel to stations where their reproductive rights are respected. Our servicemembers and their families are already sacrificing many of their personal freedoms by defending our country.

They do not get to pick where they are posted and they may have very good reasons to put off having children. I love America, I love the military, and it would be an honor to protect the reproductive rights of servicemembers as a Congressman.

I know that times are tough, but the night is always darkest before dawn. Last night we saw the cost of defeat – we need to do everything we can to win in November.

**[Keep the House from falling into the hands of extremists who would trample on our constitutional rights by sending in a donation of $3 today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44962304/343856853/-96927706?refcode=em-5.4.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDAyMzdlYy05NmNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bMtmCTbjSxG-Dh1RSHeinp8DLclZ2eU2DBmbD7bdm1U=)**

Thanks again,

Max

This small business week, we want to encourage everyone to shop locally — support our unique shops and restaurants and the folks who work to make them great! And remember all of the professional services offered by local business owners like accounting, consulting and health.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Speaker Nancy Pelosi is backing anti-abortion Henry Cuellar in TX-28.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105610?refcode=em20220505-23192&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23192%2E1203867%2EZCPFrk ]Photos of Henry Cuellar and Nancy Pelosi with headline from Vice News
that reads: Nancy Pelosi is Trying to Save An Anti-Choice Democrat as Roe
v. Wade Falls. Sub-headline reads: South Texas Rep. Henry Cuellar is one
of the last remaining anti-choice Democrats

Cuellar was the ONLY Democrat in the U.S. House to vote against abortion
protections last year AND he received an award from the March for Life —
an extreme right-wing anti-abortion group.

Justice Democrats is backing Jessica Cisneros in TX-28, the candidate that
will always fight to protect abortion rights. We need all the grassroots
support we can get, right now, to defeat conservative, anti-abortion,
Pelosi-backed Henry Cuellar on May 24.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105610?refcode=em20220505-23192&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23192%2E1203867%2EZCPFrk ]Peter, can
you fuel our fight to defeat Henry Cuellar? We need to show the Democratic
Party that we won’t settle for the same conservative corporate
anti-abortion incumbents.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105610?refcode=em20220505-23192&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23192%2E1203867%2EZCPFrk ]Contribute

News of the draft SCOTUS opinion overturning Roe v. Wade, makes this
headline even more confounding:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105610?refcode=em20220505-23192&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=23192%2E1203867%2EZCPFrk ]Vice News headline reads Nancy Pelosi is Trying to Save An Anti-Choice
Democrat as Roe v. Wade Falls

How can a Democratic leader like Pelosi support an anti-abortion
candidate? A core position of the party is the right to choose. So, why is
Pelosi supporting a Democrat that voted against the Women’s Health
Protection Act, which would have codified Roe v. Wade into law?

By backing Cuellar, Democratic House leadership and Nancy Pelosi show how
out of touch they are with Democratic voters. We must ensure that we
defeat anti-abortion Democrats, and we must ensure our leaders support
pro-choice candidates.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105610?refcode=em20220505-23192&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=23192%2E1203867%2EZCPFrk ]We need to defeat the only anti-abortion Democrat in the House, and we
only have 3 weeks left to do it. Can you chip in $3 to help
us elect Jessica in TX-28?

Thank you so much for stepping up at this critical time.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=23192%2E1203867%2EZCPFrk ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1026&akid=23192%2E1203867%2EZCPFrk ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

| Peter, it’s official. The United States Supreme Court has confirmed that Justice Alito’s draft opinion is authentic and indicates the court’s plan to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.

Though **abortion is still legal right now** , this is a serious warning sign for what’s to come, so we must be ready. Moments like this call on all of us to a higher purpose. Above division and mudslinging, we must rise to hold one another close and defend our right to our bodies.

The true enemy is the modern GOP and their right-wing apparatus. They are the ones who pose the biggest threat to civil rights in recent American history. I refuse to engage in any divisiveness among members of my own party. Now is the time for us to come together and unify against the real threat.

I’ve been in this fight before, and I’m ready to go another round. [_**If you’re with me in this fight, would you consider pitching in a few dollars to Emily’s List and so we can elect more pro-choice women?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44962655/343858522/397881982?emci=8e5ef28a-e5ca-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTNjN2FhNi05OWNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8dvmRASgAuAu2UUYjbZ3XT6W1TMunm0dwF9dM2ZvraU=)

I am wholly committed to defending and expanding reproductive rights as I’ve proven time and again in the State Senate. So, in Congress, you can count on me to be a solid vote to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law.
