As an educator, I know personally how impactful teachers can be in the lives of their students – _and vice versa!_ My students are the reason I ran for Congress!! I deeply believe in the power of education. It helped me change my life. With the support of my community, I finished high school, made it to college, and earned two advanced degrees. **Ultimately, I was able to realize my dream of becoming a high school history teacher and went on to be named 2016 National Teacher of the Year.** I may not be in the classroom every day anymore,_but there’s no such thing as a former teacher._ I took my experience and perspective as an educator to Congress, and since taking office, I have fought for equitable access to education, increased funding for our public schools, expanded access to free and reduced-price school meals for underprivileged students, higher wages for teachers and so much more. **Teachers at the table where education policy is decided?_What a novel idea._** So during this Teacher Appreciation Week, let’s not just thank our educators and school personnel – let’s commit to continuing the fight to make sure they get the respect, fair compensation, and safe and healthy schools they need to help their students thrive. **Washington needs diverse perspectives. I’m glad there was a teacher at the table for the educational crisis we all faced during the COVID pandemic – and there is so much more work to do![Will you donate to my re-election campaign so I can keep up the fight for students and teachers in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44962857/343859468/1042456465?refcode=E15423-20220506-TeacherAppreciation-SL-Education-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjU5ZmVmNy05YmNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qqyqvCYdHjBpRw9S52Fxml3YFHSEmABBqH_7i4Uy4mA=)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44962858/343859469/1042456465?refcode=E15423-20220506-TeacherAppreciation-SB-Education-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MjU5ZmVmNy05YmNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qqyqvCYdHjBpRw9S52Fxml3YFHSEmABBqH_7i4Uy4mA=)

clean_body: It’s National Teacher Appreciation Week! | | Friends, It’s National Teacher Appreciation Week! This week is an opportunity to thank the millions of teachers across the country who work tirelessly to ensure our students are learning and thriving. As an educator, I know personally how impactful teachers can be in the lives of their students – and vice versa! My students are the reason I ran for Congress!! I deeply believe in the power of education. It helped me change my life. With the support of my community, I finished high school, made it to college, and earned two advanced degrees. Ultimately, I was able to realize my dream of becoming a high school history teacher and went on to be named 2016 National Teacher of the Year. I may not be in the classroom every day anymore,but there’s no such thing as a former teacher. I took my experience and perspective as an educator to Congress, and since taking office, I have fought for equitable access to education, increased funding for our public schools, expanded access to free and reduced-price school meals for underprivileged students, higher wages for teachers and so much more. Teachers at the table where education policy is decided?What a novel idea. So during this Teacher Appreciation Week, let’s not just thank our educators and school personnel – let’s commit to continuing the fight to make sure they get the respect, fair compensation, and safe and healthy schools they need to help their students thrive. Washington needs diverse perspectives. I’m glad there was a teacher at the table for the educational crisis we all faced during the COVID pandemic – and there is so much more work to do | = Thank you, – Jahana | | About Jahana** Jahana Hayes proudly represents Connecticut's 5th Congressional district. | | Friend,

Hardworking Georgians have been**crushed by Joe Biden** and the Radical Left’s disastrous policies. They are facing _real hardship_ , but instead of focusing on solutions, all my opponents seem to be arguing about is who is the most “Pro-Trump.”

**We all miss President Trump’s policies** that Made America Great Again. I am focused on solutions, not childish arguments. [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=f3a83b7be2&e=598f6aa24c) When I am elected, I will defend and advance President Trump’s policies in Congress to deliver for the people of Georgia.

_I am focused on listening to the concerns of our district,_ not arguing with my opponents and playing petty politics. That is why I am the **real Conservative Candidate** in this race. I will deliver and not be consumed by bitter DC politics. [**If you want an Adult in The Room to Actually Deliver For Georgia, Join My Team Today!**](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=fcab4b32fd&e=598f6aa24c) I will fight every day to **defend President Trump’s policies** from being repealed and fight to restore the ones that have.

Together we can put this country back on the right track, but not by playing politics. We need bold leadership.
[](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=06724e6c48&e=598f6aa24c) [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=35b053f57e&e=598f6aa24c) [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=204387482f&e=598f6aa24c) [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=026f5deb61&e=598f6aa24c) Thank you,

David Curry

It's time for true leaders—who will be workhorses for the people, not political show ponies—so that we can focus on the real issues that face us and find common sense solutions to these challenges. | | | It's important that we get this message out, friend. Ronald Reagan once said, "there's no limit to what you can accomplish if you don't care who gets the credit." Now, more than ever, America needs true selfless leaders. Thank you, An America United P.S. Thank you for your support! Team Bochetto Bochetto for Senate · PA 19102, United States

Hello everyone,
My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!)
As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events.
**No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate.** Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him.
Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. His soul is Iowa’s. **But if Mike is going to win, turn Iowa blue, and fix the many challenges Iowa, its citizens, and this nation face, he needs your help today.**

clean_body: Hello everyone, My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades. Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!) As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events. No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate. Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him. Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. His soul is Iowa’s. But if Mike is going to win, turn Iowa blue, and fix the many challenges Iowa, its citizens, and this nation face, he needs your help today. Dear Friend,

From what we've heard, tons of dark money being thrown at our congressional races isn't coming from inside the state.

For instance, the United Democracy Project has flooded almost $1 million into the Pittsburgh race for Congress, and it’s being used exclusively to attack progressive candidate Summer Lee. None of those funds raised came from inside our state, and most of it comes from organizations that are supporting Republicans, including more than 100 hardliners who fought to overturn the last presidential election — people who should be held accountable for supporting the anti-democratic "Big Lie."

We cannot have dark money like this coming into PA to manipulate our elections. We need leaders here who are raised up by the people - candidates who know the real issues Pennsylvanians face daily and act to correct them.

Keystone Progress is working to advance progressive policies by mobilizing and organizing voters, and letting them know what is going on behind the scenes of their elections. 45,222.
That’s the number of firearm-related deaths in 2020 according to CDC data. It’s the most gun deaths since the CDC began tracking the data in 1968.
Those are tragic numbers, to be sure. But one number inside a Johns Hopkins study of the data lights the way forward:
“States with stronger gun laws have lower rates of gun violence.” For example, “Someone living in Mississippi was 8.5x more likely to die by violence than someone living in Hawaii.”
So here’s the deal:
Giffords is fighting for stronger gun laws in state after state, because while we wait for federal change, we know we can save lives in places like California, Colorado, Maryland and more.

| Peter,

In just a moment, I'm going to ask you to [_**contribute to our re-election campaign.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZyNAuhgI_FHbQEHMim6gJmGiD56fz1dKFoSlcG9K_aY=/09DqvyVTIXydAXcipB04vhSWVVQsCQGjCR6p_87OORA=?refcode=BLU-SPAN-20220505-1-EM&amount=25) But before I do, I want to give you an update on one of my top priorities in Congress - _**expanding broadband internet access across Virginia.**_

I know having reliable access to high-speed internet is key in closing opportunity gaps in our economy and education system and in improving life for people in VA-07 - **which is why I work hard to support broadband internet expansion.**

Last year, I was proud to vote for the American Rescue Plan which allowed Virginia to pursue universal broadband internet access for everyone across our Commonwealth, and I took pride in getting the bipartisan infrastructure package across the finish line to make sure we finally close our country's digital divide.

I am working hard to ensure all our communities - rural and urban - have access to broadband internet. No one should be without a connection online, and I'm driven to solve this issue.

And with the signing of these two transformative laws, Virginia can fund broadband internet expansion to the communities that need it most. With my action in Congress, we're working to update coverage maps to illustrate gaps and ensure no one is left out of the picture.

I'm honored to take up this work in Congress, [_**and**I n** eed your support to ensure I can continue advocating for our community. Will you contribute to our campaign today?**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/ZyNAuhgI_FHbQEHMim6gJmGiD56fz1dKFoSlcG9K_aY=/09DqvyVTIXydAXcipB04vhSWVVQsCQGjCR6p_87OORA=?refcode=BLU-SPAN-20220505-1-EM&amount=25)

| FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What is Summer of 1776? Summer of 1776 is Congressman Dan Crenshaw's annual Independence Day Celebration and the most patriotic party in America. A salute to all the things that make America the greatest country on Earth to LIVE FREE AND PARTY: live music, fireworks, family games, swim activities, festive food, and ice-cold drinks. This year, we're bringing the celebration to Starshine Texas - a 25-acre outdoor, recreational venue located in the heart of Humble, Texas. Starshine is home to a hillside concert arena, a lake, picnic areas, a luxurious clubhouse, and a playground for children. What to expect? Doors open for General Admission ticket holders at 4:00pm. Enjoy the family-friendly games and swimming activities, food trucks, and cash bars with beer and patriotic refreshments available for purchase. Attendees may bring their own lawn chairs and shade umbrellas and claim a spot in one of the designated areas near the concert stage or utilize the limited number of first-come, first-serve picnic tables. All General Admission areas are outdoors - shady areas, cooling misters, and tents will be around for folks who want a break from the Sun. VIP ticket holders will have access to the indoor clubhouse (see below for more information about VIP tickets). The live concert begins at 5:30pm with country music artist Shane Profitt. At 7:00pm, chart-topping country music singer Chris Janson - with hit songs like "Buy Me A Boat", "Good Vibes", and "Fix A Drink" \- takes the stage for an all-American show country music performance. At 8:30pm, the epic fireworks show commences. Following the end of the fireworks show around 9:00pm, we will have a nighttime DJ show for everyone who wants to dance and keep the good times rolling! What do VIP tickets include? In addition to access to all General Admission areas, VIP ticket holders have access to the indoor, air-conditioned clubhouse with first-come, first-serve lounge and table seating, a catered buffet, a cash bar with premium beer, wine and cocktails, and clubhouse balcony views of the concert stage. VIP ticket holders also receive early access to the venue beginning at 3:00pm (General Admission ticket holders may enter beginning at 4:00pm). VIP tickets are extremely limited and must be purchased in advance of the event. For questions about VIP tickets, please email us at events@crenshawforcongress.com or call 281-888-4016. Are children allowed to attend Summer of 1776? All ages are welcome! Our children's play area has a lot of fun games and activities to keep them entertained. However, after the fireworks show ends around 9pm the nighttime DJ show will be loud and better suited for the 21+ crowd. Do children have to pay to attend? Children under the age of 10 may attend for free but they must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. Please enter the number of children under the age of 10 accompanying you in the checkout form on Eventbrite. Everyone else must pay the full ticket price for General Admission or VIP.
Should I bring a swimsuit?
Swimsuits are definitely recommended if you plan to float or swim in the lake. We will also have a slip 'n slide for kids to enjoy. What is the registration process like? Simple! General Admission (GA) and VIP tickets are available for purchase at our Eventbrite link. Eventbrite will email your tickets. Please save your tickets and bring them to the event. We will scan your ticket's QR code to verify it and you'll be given a GA or VIP wristband. The wristband will allow you to come and go from the event as you please. If you lose your ticket or have any questions, please email us at events@crenshawforcongress.com. What's the parking situation like? Park for free at our nearby offsite parking location (to be announced soon) and ride one of the complimentary, air-conditioned shuttles to Starshine Texas.
Parking will not be available on-site at Starshine Texas.
What is the shuttle service schedule? Shuttles will begin running from the offsite parking lot to Starshine at approximately 2:40pm. Expect shuttle buses to run between Starshine and the parking location approximately every 5 - 7 minutes. These times are subject to change.
Can we use Uber or another rideshare service to reach Starshine?
Yes! We highly recommend using a rideshare service. We will have a designated zone at Starshine for ridesharing and anyone who wants to be picked up/dropped off by a friend or relative.
Will there be seating? Summer of 1776 is a festival-style celebration. Lawn seating is first-come, first-serve with the event being standing room only. If you want to get comfortable on the lawn, we recommend bringing your lawn chair and/or picnic blanket. A limited number of outdoor picnic tables will be available first-come, first-serve for General Admission ticket holders. VIP ticket holders will have access to the VIP Clubhouse with a limited number of first-come, first-serve tables and lounge seating.
Are pets allowed at Starshine Texas?
Starshine Texas does not permit pets on property. Exceptions are made for registered service animals.
Can I bring my own food and alcohol?
Outside food and beverages are not allowed in Starshine Texas. General Admission ticketholders will have access to a variety of food trucks along with cash bars serving beer and non-alcoholic refreshments. VIP ticketholders will have access to the catered buffet inside the Clubhouse.
Are firearms or weapons permitted at the event?
All weapons, including concealed firearms, are prohibited at this event and on the premises of Starshine Texas. Off-duty police officers will be providing security at the event and all visitors must pass through metal detectors to enter the premises.

For all other questions, please email us at [events@crenshawforcongress.com](mailto:events@crenshawforcongress.com) or call 281-888-4016.

name: Deroy Murdock
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
I hope your day is going well. I’m writing to let you know about something I think you’ll find useful in your learning.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zu8500dn4ri710i194i9i6qpn6bgrffop33iqd98_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onhmhp38ojkmior3dj268oe8t9ke8q74tb1cdhm4orgcaqrcd5l6pj34ctgclp6fduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdkmdij0sjmcoo7eddhcuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb4ctjm6pj1c9h2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z0j0ru75u0ebu6afbdgq7e880ivkl16qn42ou9ao_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctjm6pj1c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zop3me3tatesnh3qp6vm44obeeh20duv984c5sso_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctjm6pj1c9h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zbmgrl8l3ieihu4t0gnca4vani1qngv2d8hhseoo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctjm6pj1c9h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Here is the latest from the Aadland for Congress newsroom:

Today, Republican candidate for Congress Erik Aadland, proudly announces a formal endorsement from Fremont County Commissioner and former Colorado State Senator, Kevin Grantham.
In 2010, Senator Grantham was elected to the Colorado State Senate, serving with distinction until 2018, where he finished his terms as the President of the Senate.
In January, 2021, Senator Grantham continued his distinguished public service to Colorado by winning a seat as Fremont County Commissioner, where he currently serves today.
In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Senator Grantham said:

"Erik Aadland is a tremendous example of intelligence, experience and drive that will serve Colorado and the nation well for decades to come. Following graduation from West Point, Erik proved himself a strong and accomplished combat leader whose mettle was tested on the battlefields of Iraq and Afghanistan. Erik then proved himself in business and his experience from the energy sector will be a powerful contribution to congress. He will be one of the few members who has real, practical experience in solving complex issues and implementing feasible and lasting solutions. Getting things done is Erik's record and he is clearly the most prepared leader in this election. I fully endorse his candidacy to represent the 7th Congressional District."

|

---
| "I am extremely grateful to receive Kevin Grantham's endorsement. He has served Colorado with distinction protecting our citizens rights in local and state leadership positions. His thorough, proven understanding of Colorado and its citizens makes this endorsement all the more meaningful. I will continue to seek his wise counsel."

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: How we’ll fight for reproductive freedom in Texas
body:
Dear Derek,
We got some tough news on Monday night when we learned that the Supreme Court is readying to overturn Roe v. Wade.
Since Texas has a “trigger ban” in place, this decision will completely ban abortion in our state, without exception for rape or incest. But we have an opportunity to channel our frustration and anger into action, and ultimately into victory. We must do so because winning political power is the only way to meet this challenge — the only way to overcome this crisis.
As governor, I will do everything in my power to guarantee that women have control over their own bodies, their own health care, their own futures. But, in order to win, I need your support to defeat Greg Abbott in November.
Will you split a contribution between CommonGood and this campaign to help me defeat Greg Abbott in November so I can fight to protect the right to abortion care in Texas? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto]
These extreme attacks on abortion have never been about life. If it were about life, then the current Texas governor wouldn’t allow so many kids to die in the foster care system in Texas — the worst run foster care program in the United States. This is about control. And this is about power.
Our side — the side of the people who believe in democracy, the constitution, and the rights of our fellow Americans — has to get serious about political power. It’s on us, the people of Texas. We must do everything in our power to organize, win, and protect reproductive health care.
I will fight for every person’s freedom to control their own health care, their own body, their own future. Firstname, I need you in this fight with me to protect reproductive rights in Texas.
Please, split a $25 contribution between CommonGood and our campaign and help me defeat an extremist governor who is actively tearing away people’s reproductive freedom. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_beto?refcode=20220505_CGVA_Beto]
With your support, I know that we can win this race.
Thank you,
Beto

body:

[](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=28570d711e964c4c9f6f09e302139b8c&_e=S1RSA3_bJLOkIBkOXz5U-daW8wkcG5xGvvLaI8Eh61kwbPkzmmgkWsFId9xrLzTaR-PcVGDW3MSLOOlkqFWsqsMblUxJxZTRuUFe-GHsClJL1Y1dc9zBf_KUKRwzOkf5WzTZRZmPGL9ls-uiRmuh-cKFEhKUwKEjT9KvMTJiKsraOKTD7MQ_3t_v07FeKGGNHgfkxno6njAsnNwnfrfB_tux74hJtYDtkvHZWmfD49IVvxrDGeXMDLE8IUQa10V-SWCimdLGKnQjRPj3AseQsg%3D%3D)
_**Championing Consumer Freedom in Health Care | Opinion**_
By Bobby Jindal
The Biden administration recently announced a rule change expanding Obamacare subsidies, moving over a million Americans from employer-provided coverage to exchanges. The mainstream media dutifully reported millions would pay lower premiums, without noting health care costs would often simply be transferred from employers to taxpayers—showing, in miniature, the effect of progressives' Medicare for All plan. Conservatives criticized these and other subsidy expansions in Biden's American Rescue Plan for increasing dependency on government assistance.

Liberals and conservatives frequently talk past each other when debating health care reform, since the former prioritize coverage while the latter prioritize freedom. Liberals blame Republicans for the failures of the current health care system, especially its rapidly escalating costs, mistaking the status quo for a true market-based system.

Conservatives must articulate what a consumer-centered health care system actually entails. Looking at health care options in terms of the freedom they give consumers can clarify the choices politicians have to make on the issue, and help inform incremental reforms that move the nation's dysfunctional health system towards that ideal.

The freest option along the current health care spectrum involves individual consumers purchasing health care services, backed by catastrophic insurance, high-deductible plans, high-risk pools or health savings accounts to help them afford expensive care. Consumers need price and quality transparency tools, and protection from surprise billing, to help them navigate a complicated marketplace. Donald Trump and Joe Biden both supported price transparency regulations, but providers have been slow to comply. Trump enacted the No Surprises Act, but Biden's regulations have been challenged in court.

Consumers would benefit from changes in the tax code and more flexible health savings accounts to help them pay for services, and increased access to direct primary care and other arrangements to contract with providers. Employers can follow the lead of California's state pension system and provide reimbursements tied to reference pricing, sharing savings with employees who choose lower-cost providers and services.

Empowering consumers results in more competition, lower prices and higher quality, but giving patients more choices and control is worthwhile regardless of the expected financial benefits. Conservatives want to remove government and insurance bureaucrats from the doctor-patient relationship. They want to return insurance to its intended purpose of pooling large risks over large populations and long timeframes, rather than serving as prepaid coverage with a short-term payout. That means disempowering middlemen who profit from an opaque and inflationary health care marketplace, and disrupting the oligopolistic market that favors a limited number of large payers and hospital systems in local markets.

The second freest option includes association health, Farm Bureau, limited-benefit and short-term limited duration plans. These are the few remaining elements of the individual and small group insurance market left untouched by Obamacare's sweeping regulations. Trump expanded access to these plans, and states have enacted legislation exempting them from Obamacare regulations, but Trump's rules are being challenged in court and could be removed by Biden. Conservatives want consumers to be able to choose for themselves what coverage levels they need, which often vary over a person's lifetime and circumstances, and to benefit from resulting lower premiums.

The third freest option involves traditional employer-provided coverage, where human resources departments limit the plan providers and benefit designs employees can select. Conservatives want employees to have more control over the tax-advantaged employer subsidy spent on their behalf, for example by expanding health reimbursement arrangements, while recognizing some employees prefer the simplicity of allowing employers to negotiate plan designs and provider networks.

The fourth freest option involves exchange, Medicaid managed care and Medicare Advantage plans; differentiation and competition between these plans are limited by government regulations. Obama falsely promised the Affordable Care Act would allow Americans to keep their health plans and doctors. The exchange plans allow limited private plan competition, but the government strictly controls and standardizes benefit design, cost sharing, premium inputs and profit margins. Under this model, health plans act like regulated utilities, with reduced incentives and opportunities to innovate and meet customer needs. "You can have any color you want, as long as it is black" may be funny when describing Model Ts, but leaves patients at the mercy of government bureaucrats.

Medicare plans have more flexibility than Medicaid plans, and both offer incentives for providers and patients to follow best practices, lower costs and improve outcomes. Private plans, such as those available through Medicare, have more freedom to adopt innovative disease management models; use efficiency savings to add new benefits; deploy new technology; reduce fraud, abuse and overutilization; and encourage patients to utilize higher quality providers. Yet even these plans are tightly controlled and standardized by government regulators when it comes to cost sharing, benefit design, provider networks, premiums, and profits.

The least free option is government-run Medicaid and Medicare plans, where government agencies set prices and make coverage decisions; this serves as the foundation for Medicare for All. Conservatives must address affordability concerns as they pursue freedom, lest frustrated voters be tempted by a single payer system's superficial savings. Providers counted 130,000 pages of rules and regulations in Medicare, and a Clinton health official noted the inherent complexity of setting 10,000 prices in 3,000 counties. Setting prices too high or too low distorts the market and interferes with patient access to high-quality care. Coverage decisions based on Quality Adjusted Life Year considerations or average utilization result in rationed care and overutilization. A top-down, one-size-fits-all administered pricing approach disempowers patients in favor of government bureaucrats and results in wasted resources and worse outcomes.

This health care freedom framework helps inform policy tradeoffs—for example, preferring Obama Democrats buttressing exchanges as a defense against a more radical Sanders government-run plan; designing employer coverage to include portability, reference pricing and more options; reforming Medicare and Medicaid to include private plans and ultimately premium support and premium assistance. Conservatives can win the health care debate, but they must first know where they are going.

My family’s military service and my time in uniform made me who I am today.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44967552/343882616/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWRlMWZmYi1hZGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e5_odLBb8NSZtbzDOp_tw99kl9GgQ9QP2-b-U1KUqNw=) Peter,

In my life, service has been a calling and leadership a privilege.

My father, Alvin Baldus, was proud of his service in the Army’s 2nd Infantry Division. The horrors of war he experienced on the front lines in the Korean War were difficult for him to share, and he suffered from the memories. Dad demonstrated leadership in representing America’s Korean War veterans at official ceremonies in Seoul in 2013 to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Armistice that ended hostilities in the Korean War. He did this despite suffering from Parkinson’s from the effects of DDT in the war. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44967553/343882644/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWRlMWZmYi1hZGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e5_odLBb8NSZtbzDOp_tw99kl9GgQ9QP2-b-U1KUqNw=) _My father serving in Korea_ My father’s best friend in the unit was Willy McLendan, from Georgia. One night, Willy was killed while on patrol, making the ultimate sacrifice in service to our country. My father never forgot him and treasured a picture of them together for the rest of his life. My father went on to fight for equal opportunity as a state legislator and Congressman. He never stopped serving our country and others. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44967554/343882645/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWRlMWZmYi1hZGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e5_odLBb8NSZtbzDOp_tw99kl9GgQ9QP2-b-U1KUqNw=) _My father in Korea with his friend, Willy_ Every day across the globe, servicemembers are ready to pay any price for America’s safety. I’m thinking of them today, and during Military Appreciation Month, it’s important to recognize their dedication and that of their families to our country and one another.

Peter, my family’s military service and my time in uniform define who I am today. It defines who I will be as an elected representative. [In Congress, I will support our current and former servicemembers and ensure our nation’s security. Please, help me get to Washington by donating any amount today >>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44967556/343882647/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWRlMWZmYi1hZGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e5_odLBb8NSZtbzDOp_tw99kl9GgQ9QP2-b-U1KUqNw=) | ****[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44967558/343882676/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWRlMWZmYi1hZGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e5_odLBb8NSZtbzDOp_tw99kl9GgQ9QP2-b-U1KUqNw=)****

Understanding the importance of Korea to our own national security, I volunteered to serve in the 2nd Infantry Division on the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). I led my troops in harsh conditions, as we monitored the enemy just miles away. Kevin was also serving in 2ID, and we were married in the tiny military chapel on Camp Casey, surrounded by fellow soldiers.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44967560/343882680/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.19de1ffb-adcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOWRlMWZmYi1hZGNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e5_odLBb8NSZtbzDOp_tw99kl9GgQ9QP2-b-U1KUqNw=)
_Me with another officer while serving on the DMZ_

Our family has a history of standing up to protect America, and our freedoms, in hostile environments. We are facing difficult challenges in our country today, and I will never stop fighting for our families, our economy, and the strength of our nation.

clean_body: My family’s military service and my time in uniform made me who I am today. | = Peter, In my life, service has been a calling and leadership a privilege. My father, Alvin Baldus, was proud of his service in the Army’s 2nd Infantry Division. The horrors of war he experienced on the front lines in the Korean War were difficult for him to share, and he suffered from the memories. Dad demonstrated leadership in representing America’s Korean War veterans at official ceremonies in Seoul in 2013 to commemorate the 50th anniversary of the Armistice that ended hostilities in the Korean War. He did this despite suffering from Parkinson’s from the effects of DDT in the war. = My father serving in Korea My father’s best friend in the unit was Willy McLendan, from Georgia. One night, Willy was killed while on patrol, making the ultimate sacrifice in service to our country. My father never forgot him and treasured a picture of them together for the rest of his life. My father went on to fight for equal opportunity as a state legislator and Congressman. He never stopped serving our country and others. = My father in Korea with his friend, Willy Every day across the globe, servicemembers are ready to pay any price for America’s safety. I’m thinking of them today, and during Military Appreciation Month, it’s important to recognize their dedication and that of their families to our country and one another. Peter, my family’s military service and my time in uniform define who I am today. It defines who I will be as an elected representative. = | **= Understanding the importance of Korea to our own national security, I volunteered to serve in the 2nd Infantry Division on the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). ### Berrien County Clerk Endorses
Michael Brown for Governor
STEVENSVILLE – Michael Brown, Republican candidate for Governor, announced today that he has been endorsed by Sharon Tyler, Berrien County Clerk and former State Representative.

"Michael Brown is the best choice for Michigan Governor,” stated Tyler. “As a life-long Michigan resident and the only candidate who actually has elected government experience, and continues to serve citizens as a Michigan State Police Captain, he is the type of dedicated public servant we need in Lansing. He will serve our state well as Governor."
---
|
---
| Brown commented that he is honored to receive Tyler’s support. “Sharon Tyler has distinguished herself as a smart and practical leader both in the Legislature and in her current role as county clerk. I’m honored to have her support.”

Tyler joins a growing list of public officials who have endorsed Brown. State Representatives Beth Griffin and Pauline Wendzel previously endorsed Brown.

He’s also been endorsed by Sheriffs Mark Lillywhite and Scott Hodshire, County Prosecutors Steve Pierangeli and David Den Houten, as well as rocker Ted Nugent.

A more complete list of endorsements can be found on Michael Brown’s website: [captainmikeformichigan.com](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=a9dceb36a5&e=0636b97700) ###

He’s a former two-term county commissioner in Berrien County. He can be reached at[mike@captainmikeformichigan.com](mailto:mike@captainmikeformichigan.com)_

clean_body: "Michael Brown is the best choice for Michigan Governor,” stated Tyler. “He will serve our state well as Governor." | | | | | | | | | Berrien County Clerk Endorses Michael Brown for Governor STEVENSVILLE – Michael Brown, Republican candidate for Governor, announced today that he has been endorsed by Sharon Tyler, Berrien County Clerk and former State Representative. "Michael Brown is the best choice for Michigan Governor,” stated Tyler. “As a life-long Michigan resident and the only candidate who actually has elected government experience, and continues to serve citizens as a Michigan State Police Captain, he is the type of dedicated public servant we need in Lansing. He will serve our state well as Governor." | | Brown commented that he is honored to receive Tyler’s support. “Sharon Tyler has distinguished herself as a smart and practical leader both in the Legislature and in her current role as county clerk. I’m honored to have her support.” Tyler joins a growing list of public officials who have endorsed Brown. State Representatives Beth Griffin and Pauline Wendzel previously endorsed Brown. He’s also been endorsed by Sheriffs Mark Lillywhite and Scott Hodshire, County Prosecutors Steve Pierangeli and David Den Houten, as well as rocker Ted Nugent. A more complete list of endorsements can be found on Michael Brown’s website: ### | | Michael Brown is a Republican candidate for Governor of Michigan. The 34-year law enforcement veteran is currently a captain with the Michigan State Police. He’s a former two-term county commissioner in Berrien County. | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
Jake Monssen, jake@strahanforcongress.com
---
| | **DEBATE CHALLENGE: Strahan Challenges Greene to Second Debate**
---
| **DALLAS, Ga** : Republican congressional candidate Jennifer Strahan is challenging Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene to a one-on-one debate after Sunday’s spectacle on [Georgia Public Broadcasting](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=4312e28975&e=daf3f68050).

Strahan is the only competitive candidate against Greene in the GA14 contest in both polling and fundraising. Voters deserve to hear directly from the two candidates most likely to win or face each other in a run-off.

“The clear winner of Sunday’s debate was Jennifer Strahan. Rep. Greene showed the electorate exactly who she is: a pretend bully with no substance,” said Jake Monssen. “We heard a lot about what Rep. Greene is ‘going to do,’ but nothing about what she has done.”

“Voters deserve to hear more about Mrs. Greene’s disastrous record and why their Representative has nothing to show for her time in Congress,” said Jennifer Strahan.

For example, Mrs. Greene could share some insights into ...
* Why she said the Catholic church is [run by Satan](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=702c3007e3&e=daf3f68050) and she wouldn’t trust Catholic church leaders to protect her children from pedophiles, yet she [travels around Georgia](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=38e414ea7f&e=daf3f68050) with someone who said sexual relationships between 13-year-old boys and adult men and women can “happen perfectly consensually.”
* Why she said our American military men and women are [“throwing their lives away.”](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=5d1d82edb3&e=daf3f68050)
* Why she voted to de-fund our military, and even [opposed](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=606bb74a98&e=daf3f68050) efforts to prevent Iranian terrorists from obtaining drones.
* Why she promotes conspiracy theories and anti-Semitic tropes, including [Jewish space lasers](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=9efa3820e9&e=daf3f68050), [9/11](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=c6339fdb84&e=daf3f68050) was an inside job planned by the U.S. government, mass school shootings are [false flag operations](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=c482e50a5e&e=daf3f68050), and unfortunately many more.
* Why she claims to be upholding conservative values, but [votes with AOC](https://StrahanForCongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=21a96cd50be879ed37d24b0ca&id=bf68d095eb&e=daf3f68050) and the fringe left in the House 20% of the time.

The Strahan campaign prefers a traditional debate format with a moderator who will ask questions for the duration of an hour. Strahan’s team is reaching out to media outlets, Chamber organizations, and others in the district who would possibly be interested in hosting.

name: Lila Rose
subject: The end of Roe v. Wade?
body:
This is a historic moment. On Monday, a draft opinion of Dobbs v. Jackson, the U.S. Supreme Court case that would overturn Roe
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zctt712923nhlhn46l70ft6m6u9sd3retsa1baa0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctge4or4c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65stictin6p73eoojedlkseqn0o36c2rjdctlm2qj3dr761j6at3lmmom7dtn63g6fkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p32phhesqj2ptie5j3co5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)

---
| | Friend of Life, This is a historic moment. On Monday, a draft opinion of _Dobbs v. Jackson_ , the U.S. Supreme Court case that would overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , was leaked. Justices are poised to invalidate the egregious 1973 decision that led to the deaths of over 63 million preborn children; however, abortion activists are enraged. The abortion industry and lobby are now working overtime to make sure that _Roe v. Wade_ remains the law of the land. **Friend, we are in the fight of our lives. **
---
[**OVERTURN ROE — DONATE NOW »**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1ti1uqeaj0cn85pcj7p9h7arum2didape8oe4ko_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctge4or4c3h2bs)
---
Planned Parenthood and their pro-abortion allies are using their influence in Congress, in the media, and in Hollywood to codify _Roe_ and to make every state in the nation a sanctuary for abortion. They’re also trying to publicly pressure pro-life Justices to change their votes and to uphold _Roe_. We cannot let this happen. Forty-five years of _Roe_ have resulted in the deaths of over 63 million preborn children, an entire generation of Americans unjustly slaughtered. This is a battle between life and death—a battle for the soul of our country and for the lives of generations of children yet to be born. Ending _Roe_ is the right decision. It would return the issue back to the people and away from a select group of judges with an agenda. However, the abortion industry is saturating the media with a frenzy of lies, claiming that the majority of young people support _Roe v. Wade_ and that women will stand alone in a post-Roe America. The fact is that nearly 6 out of 10 of young people oppose _Roe v. Wade_ when they find out that is permits abortion through all nine months of pregnancy—and they support being able to vote on abortion policy in their state. There are also 3,000 pregnancy centers and 400 maternity homes in America ready to assist women facing unplanned or difficult pregnancies. No woman will stand alone. **Your support and your voice is critical at this time. Would you please make a generous donation to Live Action today to ensure that Roe is overturned and abortion ends??** **Specifically, I am looking for ****15 people who believe in the sanctity of human life, to step forward and make a $30 gift before midnight tonight.**[**https://give.liveaction.org/ensure-roe-is-overturned/**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbiqs35b55pl47c18dduvpv72jtlqrtsdm1bmht0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctge4or4c3h2bs) Your gift of any amount will go towards saving preborn children from abortion and give us the resources to continue to influence the culture so that abortion becomes not only illegal but unthinkable. It will also ensure that we can keep up the pressure on judges and elected officials to save the innocent preborn children at risk instead of caving to the pro-death abortion lobby. Every day, we receive messages from young men and women who changed their minds on abortion after watching a Live Action video or reading an article that affirms the dignity of human life. However, for every dollar we spend, the abortion industry is spending millions to target young people with pro-abortion lies. We must reach them before the abortion lobby does. Please make a generous gift to help Live Action continue changing hearts and minds on abortion and to build a society that cherishes and embraces every human life. You can make your gift here: [https://give.liveaction.org/ensure-roe-is-overturned/](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za64um6nidfbm2p137ligd6lkg0l19e2bs18mlm8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4ctge4or4c3h2bs) Thank you for standing with us during this most critical moment.
---
| | For Life,

**Lila Rose
** Founder and President
---

clean_body: Kina dominated the first debate! | | | Dear Team, Last night we had our first debate of the cycle, and the contrast could not have been more clear. Kina proved exactly what this race between her and Representative Danny Davis is: an obvious choice between someone who’s been in Congress for 25 years without much to show for it, and someone who will be ready to represent this district and lead this country forward on her first day in office. From abortion to climate change to healthcare to housing, Kina provided crisp, clear, and compelling responses to each question that came her way, Here is something Kina said last night that really stuck with me “Abortion rights are set to be banned before assault rifles are here in the United States of America. And to me, electeds have not done enough in order to protect women and girls. Congressman Davis, you diminished the work that I did around the Illinois Council on Women and Girls act, which specifically talked about protecting abortion rights here in Illinois... In Congress, I will fight every day to protect reproductive rights. And when you come to my office, if I need to drive you myself, we will get you safe access to abortion care. ” I think Kina captured the reality of this race best in her closing: “This pandemic has exposed to us that these urgent crises that are breaking out require urgent leadership. And the fact is, we have not felt the presence of Congressman Davis. Friend,

Like many of you, I woke up devastated, but resolved to continue our fight for reproductive freedom.

In the wake of last night's horrifying news that the Supreme Court privately voted to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , I immediately thought of the life-changing experience a close friend shared with me. I asked her if she'd be willing to share it with you today:
> _"The year was 1970, just a month before abortion became legal in New York, but I couldn't wait. I was 18, young and alone. Through word of mouth, I found my way to two people performing illegal abortions in their apartment in another state. I got scared and tried to leave. The abortionist wouldn't let me go, possibly for fear of being arrested, and forced me to have the abortion in a dirty bathroom. It took another 18 years before I was emotionally ready to become a mom and have my daughter. Even then, I never got over it.
>
> I've kept this to myself for half a century, but I share my story today because people need to be reminded of how it was before Roe. **We must resolve to never return to the backrooms.** "_
My friend lived through this trauma the year before I was born. Two decades later, when I faced down an unplanned pregnancy of my own, I was able to _choose_ to have my oldest daughter with the support and resources of a local Planned Parenthood.

Thanks to the generations who fought for reproductive freedom before me, I had the right to choose and the support that every woman deserves when making such a consequential decision. Now, we must fight for the young women of today and tomorrow -- for their bodily autonomy, constitutional rights, and safety.

clean_body: The right to abortion, and bodily autonomy, is under attack at the federal level. We need to come together and fight back. | | | | | Team, Access to abortion is a fundamental right, and one we’ll always fight for on Team Sonia. With the news that the Supreme Court is poised to overturn Roe v. Wade, I want to remind you that the legal right to abortion will remain safe in Massachusetts no matter what, but we have a lot of work to do to increase access and ensure our Commonwealth shines bright as a sanctuary for those seeking care from other states. We have to come together to protect this fundamental right. Before joining Sonia on the campaign trail, I was proud to work for Planned Parenthood to help pass the ROE Act to protect and expand abortion access in Massachusetts. I’ve seen the work Sonia has done to expand reproductive freedom and equity at the State House, and it’s part of why I was so excited to join this team. People with wealth and means will always be able to access abortion — they can afford to travel, take time off from work, or afford to pay out of pocket. We cannot allow this essential health care to become a privilege. subject: Real quick... watch
body:
(New campaign video) |
---
| | Hey there,

The election to save Idaho is less than two weeks away!

It's been a huge blessing getting to know so many people through events, forums, meetups, and of course, knocking on doors.

My overall feeling?

Idahoans are **FIRED UP.**

Because we're sick of career politicians wrecking our state. And we're not going down without a fight.

I recently participated in a candidate forum alongside my opponent and others. Although some of the questions were... _odd... _it was still fun to get in front of my district and meet new people.

[](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=5c55c17a7b&e=dea908e0fe)

[You can read about that here](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=c768a147e8&e=dea908e0fe).

So I'm optimistic.

And I'm confident we'll see a huge red liberty wave on May 17th.

So, thanks for your support, it means a lot.

It's been very humbling...

All of the people who have thrown their weight behind me... I take it VERY seriously and I'm thrilled to get to work for IDAHO CITIZENS (not big business) after I win.

I even had Nampa City Councilman Jacob Bower recently say this about me:

"Brian Lenney has been a long-time patient of my office and a friend who is honest, loyal, and devoted to his Christian faith. Brian is an amazing husband and father of four and is someone who many of my south Nampa friends and family know and trust. As someone who lives in district 13, we need a liberty-minded, small-government advocate in our state senate. I recently have been extremely disappointed in our state senate and specifically Jeff Agenbroad. We don’t need elected officials who constantly vote to expand government programs and who vote to impose restrictions on businesses and individual freedoms. On Nampa City Council, I have constantly voted against any business lockdowns, and mandates, and have been constant in voting against any higher taxes and government growth. The truth is you can’t differentiate Jeff's votes from liberal Senate Democrats. I’m also concerned when politicians have thousands of campaign dollars from large special interest groups, associations, and pharmaceutical companies. I know Brian Lenney will vote to put the power back into the hands of the people and not into the hands of government and its special interests groups."

How awesome is it to have men like him serving our city?

I'm honored to have his support.

So, the finish line is in sight.

I've raised more money than the other guy, outworked him, outhustled him, and I'm hoping... Nampa voters see that I'm the right man for the job.

Stay tuned!

Brian

**P.S. **I just put out [**a new video about my race for state senate in Nampa.**](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=4b96509dc6&e=dea908e0fe "watch it") It's short but... effective. If you can, please watch and share.

---

You can watch the video on the link below if you don't have or want to login to Fascistbook:

[Watch the video](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=23741393a1&e=dea908e0fe "Watch it")

Thanks,

Brian

\-----------
\-----------

Hey there,

The election to save Idaho is less than two weeks away!

It's been a huge blessing getting to know so many people through events, forums, meetups, and of course, knocking on doors.

My overall feeling?

Idahoans are **FIRED UP.**

Because we're sick of career politicians wrecking our state. And we're not going down without a fight.

I recently participated in a candidate forum alongside my opponent and others. Although some of the questions were... _odd... _it was still fun to get in front of my district and meet new people.

[](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=45ca37f7bb&e=dea908e0fe)

[You can read about that here](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=9297941098&e=dea908e0fe).

So I'm optimistic.

And I'm confident we'll see a huge red liberty wave on May 17th.

So, thanks for your support, it means a lot.

It's been very humbling...

All of the people who have thrown their weight behind me... I take it VERY seriously and I'm thrilled to get to work for IDAHO CITIZENS (not big business) after I win.

I even had Nampa City Councilman Jacob Bower recently say this about me:

"Brian Lenney has been a long-time patient of my office and a friend who is honest, loyal, and devoted to his Christian faith. Brian is an amazing husband and father of four and is someone who many of my south Nampa friends and family know and trust. As someone who lives in district 13, we need a liberty-minded, small-government advocate in our state senate. I recently have been extremely disappointed in our state senate and specifically Jeff Agenbroad. We don’t need elected officials who constantly vote to expand government programs and who vote to impose restrictions on businesses and individual freedoms. On Nampa City Council, I have constantly voted against any business lockdowns, and mandates, and have been constant in voting against any higher taxes and government growth. The truth is you can’t differentiate Jeff's votes from liberal Senate Democrats. I’m also concerned when politicians have thousands of campaign dollars from large special interest groups, associations, and pharmaceutical companies. I know Brian Lenney will vote to put the power back into the hands of the people and not into the hands of government and its special interests groups."

How awesome is it to have men like him serving our city?

I'm honored to have his support.

So, the finish line is in sight.

I've raised more money than the other guy, outworked him, outhustled him, and I'm hoping... Nampa voters see that I'm the right man for the job.

Stay tuned!

Brian

**P.S. **I just put out [**a new video about my race for state senate in Nampa.**](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=833c804819&e=dea908e0fe "watch it") It's short but... effective. If you can, please watch and share.

--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_

Team, Tuesday was a devastating day for so many of us as we awoke to news that the U.S. Supreme Court is planning to overturn _Roe v. Wade_. If this decision is finalized, it would mean the end to federal protections for reproductive choice and open the floodgates to extreme abortion bans in Republican-controlled states across the country. While this unprecedented attack on reproductive freedom is a shock to the system, it is unfortunately not surprising. Republicans at the state and federal levels have set their sights on overturning _Roe_ since it was settled back in 1973, and they succeeded by stacking the courts with far-right judges and introducing extreme abortion restrictions in state legislatures. I saw similar attacks on Marylanders’ right to choose while representing District 15 in the Maryland State House from 2010-2019, and fiercely opposed them. _Abortion rights are human rights_ , and Wes and I will work to enshrine the right to choose into Maryland’s constitution so access to abortion is never in jeopardy. **In the meantime, the U.S. Senate can take action right now to codify _Roe v. clean_body: Beijing Biden refuses to acknowledge freedom-loving Taiwan while he rolls out the red carpet for the Chinese Communist Party. Peter, Beijing Biden refuses to acknowledge freedom-loving Taiwan while he rolls out the red carpet for the Chinese Communist Party. Don’t be fooled: China wants to overtake the United States as the world’s superpower and take away your freedom. Joe Biden has made it clear that he’d rather cozy up to communists than stand up for democracy, so it’s up to Republicans to keep America strong - but we can’t do that unless we take back the House this November. I’ve fought for our country before, Peter, and just because I’m no longer on the battlefield doesn’t mean I’ve stopped doing everything I can to stop our enemies. The Chinese Communist Party is the SINGLE BIGGEST THREAT to America, but it seems like Republicans are the only ones worried. While we can’t trust Joe Biden to stand up for America, Republicans will stop at nothing to defeat evil communists, but we can’t start standing up to the Chinese Communist Party if we don’t take back the majority. name: Derek Kilmer
subject: America's educators are some of the most essential workers we have.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
Benjamin Franklin once wrote: "An investment in knowledge pays the greatest interest."
Peter,

I wanted to take a moment to wish you a happy National Teacher Appreciation Week! As the son of two public school teachers, I am deeply grateful for the work that our educators put in every day. Since the pandemic, teachers have stepped up in ways beyond what is already expected of them (which is a lot), so this week, especially, I want to uplift our educators and thank them for their hard work.

Our teachers have played a vital role in supporting our students to get through many of the challenges they've faced over the past two years. From helping students adapt to online learning, assisting stressed-out parents and students, and finding creative ways to keep our children feeling welcomed and engaged at school - our teachers deserve our gratitude and support.

**[Before National Teacher Appreciation Week ends, please join me in showing your support for our nation's educators by signing our card to say THANK YOU! And let's recommit to fighting for policies that support our schools, students, and teachers.](https://act.myngp.com/el/lLIdQo79mH_4AQEPCsYvWBCIvKan2E8HHBPaUmSHR8s=/0fCTIDltLvA1olh2vX7KgAXBNpLaDaxXBfNXL_PVrq8=?ms=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&refcode=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&source=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

From leading 100+ members in calling for American leadership to support global education, and securing over $12.5 million for rural schools in Washington state, I am incredibly proud of the work that we've done in Congress so far to support our educators. The American Rescue Plan alone provided essential resources to help our schools safely re-open and make up for learning loss.

Benjamin Franklin once wrote: "An investment in knowledge pays the greatest interest." The investments we make in education help America compete. They help create economic opportunity and progress. And by uplifting our educators, we set up future generations for success and growth.

**[Will you join me in empowering our teachers by signing our card before the end of the week?](https://act.myngp.com/el/lLIdQo79mH_4AQEPCsYvWBCIvKan2E8HHBPaUmSHR8s=/0fCTIDltLvA1olh2vX7KgAXBNpLaDaxXBfNXL_PVrq8=?ms=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&refcode=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&source=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220505_apprec_ecrd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

It's an honor to serve you,

Derek Kilmer

Peter Willis,
**In light of the news that the Supreme Court plans to repeal _Roe v. Wade_ while Republicans propose a national ban on abortion if they win the midterms, it is truly time for Democrats to abolish the filibuster.**
The GOP’s proposed federal legislation would reportedly outlaw abortion after six weeks, a time period during which many people do not even know they are pregnant. _We simply cannot let this happen, or countless lives will be lost._
**The Senate Democratic majority MUST act now to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act, which would codify _Roe v. Wade_ into federal law and protect the right to abortion nationwide.**
Unfortunately, faux Democratic Senators Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema still stand firmly against abolishing the filibuster, even with reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy on the line. body:
I wanted to take some time today to send over this important message.
---
| | | | | | [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Iln8KdNV4npsKZhdEiQyIIxYsp92I2gwBs-t2hK8SuRnTQCZj5CZPWJ4eIX6mECGbckXJvqaQKJi8PET9psJALQiRroPl70LhAOZnmOQDf1kMZt7uDfc2RN_nyM8TGTXSIjLqhE0mr_dYVx4DKdfDA3DPsN71bEP16XA2u6-jplysADFm4KMZ-aTCCusZMuTZWUshSgk1zMnzJOMMxdOig==&c=HTlESsVDY2CkghQSXKSw4-ctAT1oqp5vFlH4mXtJI-hjDDPKg8jC9g==&ch=_XLmYkZGdJ34AtHR-whesp1cdgJdx3aClVYiX0IAU3Lr684PcYAj8g==)
---
| Friend
I wanted to take some time today to send over this important message. The reason I originally ran for office was to prevent the federal government from doing to you and your family what they did to mine.
My family built a business and had a small cattle ranch. Growing up, I was taught grit and the value of hard work. However, an Obama-era program forced my family into eviction in 2011. We lost everything. After months of homelessness, I pulled myself up by my bootstraps and never gave up.
I didn't fall into the Left's never-ending traps of handouts and social programs. I believed in hard work and the American Dream to get me back on my feet. And I still believe that's all you need to create a life for yourself in America.
I'm proud to represent the best district, in the best state, in the greatest country in the world. As your Representative, I have always fought tooth and nail in defense of your Constitutional Liberties and the foundational values of our country.
However, the Far Left has made it clear that they don't care about America or the American Dream. Over the past year, they have crammed trillion-dollar socialist spending sprees through Congress - all on your dime. Our southern border has been left wide open for drug smuggling, cartel violence, and millions of illegal migrants. The Woke Mob has done everything to discredit the officers who protect our communities and let chaos grip our nation's cities.
Worst of all, their constant attacks on the sanctity of life are completely inhumane and un-American. 34 years ago, my mother was advised not to follow through with my birth due to health risks. Despite this, she chose life and I thank her every day for her compassion.
Needless to say, this rabid far-left agenda cannot be allowed to continue. Florida has been able to stay true to proud American Conservatism. However, we still need to win the battle on Capitol Hill.
I'm doing everything I can to light a fire under the Leftist crooks and put our way of life back in Congress. Yet, only so much can be done while we still hold the House Minority. This is why it is so important that we band together and ensure the Red Wave sweeps Congress this November.
I'm not letting hard-working Americans suffer under the Left like my family endured. [Can I count on your support so I can continue bringing our Conservative values to Congress?](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Iln8KdNV4npsKZhdEiQyIIxYsp92I2gwBs-t2hK8SuRnTQCZj5CZPWJ4eIX6mECGbckXJvqaQKJi8PET9psJALQiRroPl70LhAOZnmOQDf1kMZt7uDfc2RN_nyM8TGTXSIjLqhE0mr_dYVx4DKdfDA3DPsN71bEP16XA2u6-jplysADFm4KMZ-aTCCusZMuTZWUshSgk1zMnzJOMMxdOig==&c=HTlESsVDY2CkghQSXKSw4-ctAT1oqp5vFlH4mXtJI-hjDDPKg8jC9g==&ch=_XLmYkZGdJ34AtHR-whesp1cdgJdx3aClVYiX0IAU3Lr684PcYAj8g==)
Thanks for your support in the fight,

[1]Charles Booker

Hi, Peter. It’s
nice to meet you, I’m Rep. Ayanna Pressley.

I’m writing to you today to share why I’m so proud to endorse Charles for
U.S. Senate.

Charles has made it clear that he’s not afraid to take on big fights and
demand the change we deserve. Because, just like me, Charles understands
firsthand how high the stakes are for our families.

When you’ve lived the struggle that other politicians just talk about, you
know how much elections matter. How meaningful policies like Medicare for
All, a Green New Deal, and student debt cancellation would be for working
families.

Together, we can make sure that Charles — a champion for racial,
environmental, and economic justice — is going to replace a Senator who’s
blocked legislation that would make lynching a federal hate crime.

Today, I’m participating in an awareness walk in Toppenish to recognize the **National Day of Awareness for Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls.**

Here in our district, we’ve seen more than 32 indigenous women who have been murdered or gone missing on or around the Yakama Reservation. Cissy Reyes, who has dedicated herself to seeking justice after the murder of her sister Rosenda, is leading the fight against the injustices Yakama women face.

**_This is a nationwide crisis that can no longer be ignored._** Far too many indigenous women have gone missing or become victims to senseless violence. There are alarming numbers of unsolved cases and missing women – and indigenous women living on tribal land are murdered at a rate ten times the national average.

[We can’t wait any longer – we must act now to save the lives of indignenous women. clean_body: | | Today, I’m participating in an awareness walk in Toppenish to recognize the National Day of Awareness for Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls. Here in our district, we’ve seen more than 32 indigenous women who have been murdered or gone missing on or around the Yakama Reservation. Cissy Reyes, who has dedicated herself to seeking justice after the murder of her sister Rosenda, is leading the fight against the injustices Yakama women face. This is a nationwide crisis that can no longer be ignored. Far too many indigenous women have gone missing or become victims to senseless violence. There are alarming numbers of unsolved cases and missing women – and indigenous women living on tribal land are murdered at a rate ten times the national average. | | Thanks so much for reading this email. Peter —

Yesterday, Axios published an article naming Nikki as one of four Democratic women legislators to watch in a post- Roe America.

And you know what? They’re damn right.

Nikki has spent her career uplifting women. And after the news broke about Roe v. Wade , she leapt into action, ready — as always — to meet the moment and be a voice for Florida women.

With abortion rights on the line, we need a Governor who will fight with everything she has to protect Florida women — not a pro-life politician like DeSantis or Charlie Crist. Express Donate $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-may-2022?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=505axios]

Let’s be clear — DeSantis and his GOP cronies will ban abortion the second Roe is overturned.

If we don’t act now, we’re going to see a level of cruelty, discrimination, and outright hatred toward women like we haven’t seen in over 50 years. And there’s no question that marginalized communities will suffer the most.

Nikki understands that it’ll take more than words to win this fight — it’ll take real action. That’s why Axios named her a woman to watch.
