name: Tom Fitton
subject: YES or NO...Should We Keep Fighting for Honest Elections?
body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

I need to know, **YES** or **NO** , if you will support Judicial Watch's commitment to honest elections and our essential work fighting _against_ the Left's schemes to tilt the electoral playing field in their favor for decades to come.
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58821&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

[Thanks to the support of our members](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58821&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=), we are the nation's leading private litigator suing states that fail to follow federal law and maintain accurate voter rolls as federal law requires...the single best and most important safeguard in stopping voter fraud.

**_But time is running short_.**

Since 2020, the Left has been pressing its corrupt elections agenda forward.

Liberals in Congress are still desperately trying to "federalize" our elections, which means stripping administration of our elections from state legislatures, as the Founding Fathers intended, and handing it over to the federal government.

Specifically, handing control of our elections over to the politically-driven U.S. Department of Justice!

In the long history of bad ideas, this is one of the worst!

In response to the Left-induced election chaos of 2020, conservatives in state legislatures across the country, including **Florida, Georgia** , **Iowa** and **Texas** , passed election safeguard reforms that aim to restore voters' confidence in the honesty and accuracy of election results.

Of course, these commonsense election safeguard reforms were attacked hysterically by the Left...

...the corrupt Biden Justice Department has sued **Georgia** and **Texas** , trying to block their election law reforms, a _nd attacks are also being spearheaded by groups that are part of the massive, radical**Soros** network_.

Only one group in the country has the track record to push back in the courts and fight effectively for honest elections..._Judicial Watch_.

That's why I need to know **YES** or **NO** , if you will give us your support to do whatever it takes to expose and prosecute fraudulent election practices where we find them _and intervene in support of election integrity measures as the opportunities arise (and they already are)_.

I need to know if you will help us _go the distance_ in the fight to preserve the rule of law, and make sure that _only eligible American citizens are allowed to vote in our elections_!

[So I ask you to back up your **YES** endorsement with a special contribution and give Judicial Watch your support.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58821&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58821&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

The support we receive from our dedicated members underpin all we do and all we have achieved..._including this critically important and historic election integrity work_.

Thank you for reading my message, and I urge you to join us today!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

| **_Tyler Kistner_**
* * *
Tyler Kistner is a native Minnesotan who served 9 years on active duty, mostly in the elite Marine Special Operations Forces unit known as the Marine Raiders. Friend -- I was recently asked if I plan to endorse any other candidate for the District 4 Primary. I imagine some of you might be thinking the same thing. I want to be clear: our campaign is _**not**_ slowing down. In fact, we’ve been reaching new supporters and enrolling volunteers like never before. My message is spreading, and so is the hope that a Water Protector like me might actually get a seat at the table in Congress. Folks need to know that I am the only candidate who understands what it’s like to be a mother and an American Indian woman on the frontlines of the climate crisis. Peter, I recently attended an event at the Veteran Resource Center in Winnebago, Minnesota. What a fantastic venue to host this event. I arrived early and was honored to receive a tour of the facility, which has been created by passionate community members to provide a safe place for veterans in southern Minnesota. This event was a strong reminder that we as a country need to continually recognize the sacrifices made by the men and women of the armed forces to help us protect democracy. More importantly, we need to honor the financial and healthcare commitments we made to these veterans. As an attorney for 25 years, I’ve been honored to work shoulder-to-shoulder with veterans in pursuing VA benefits, providing volunteer legal services in clinics and pro-bono legal representation in family law or financial matters. Through these close contacts, I have a great appreciation for the emotional and financial challenges that returning Veterans face, especially following deployment. As your Congressman I will keep these issues front and center and make sure the financial commitments to our Veterans are honored. More importantly, I will fight hard to make sure that these benefits and programs reach ALL VETERANS in southern Minnesota, not just those in the metro or regional centers.

Peter, **That's right.****Early voting in our Republican Primary for Virginia's 7th Congressional District begins tomorrow.** If you haven't already, _now_ is the time to make a plan to vote!
---
[**CLICK HERE TO FIND YOUR EARLY VOTING LOCATION**](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/ec2aba03a9ecb25a/93f271eb8d4a3f71c3d6b838967d376c/40203)

First things first: **Are you registered to vote?** The voter registration period for our Republican Primary is open through May 31st, and you can [**click here to check the status of your voter registration**](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/ec2aba03a9ecb25a/5f161410c2d5d1a8c3d6b838967d376c/40203). **If your registration is all set, you're ready to cast your ballot!** For that there are a few options: **In-person voting:** You can vote in person on Primary Day (June 21st), __but you can also cast your ballot in-person beginning tomorrow morning at your local voter registrar's office__. The early voting period lasts from tomorrow, May 6th through Saturday, June 18th. [Click here to find your early voting location.](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/ec2aba03a9ecb25a/131a5a40441200dbc3d6b838967d376c/40203) **Vote by mail:** In Virginia, voters can request an absentee, mail-in ballot with no required excuse, so long as the ballot request is **_received_** by your local voter registrar by **5:00pm on Friday, June 10th**. [Click here for more information about requesting your absentee mail-in ballot and how to to submit it!](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/ec2aba03a9ecb25a/b70db830a391f33bc3d6b838967d376c/40203) Once you receive your ballot in the mail, you may return your completed ballot to your general registrar’s office by mail or personally deliver it to your general registrar. If returned by mail, your ballot will be counted if it is postmarked by **Primary Election Day on June 21st** and received by your local registrar by **Noon on Friday, June 24th**. **That's it!** Once you've submitted your ballot in person or by mail, you can [track it any time by going online to the Virginia Department of Elections website.](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/ec2aba03a9ecb25a/27f530c9e685a974c3d6b838967d376c/40203) If you're on social media - be sure to post a picture and tag us [@VoteVanuch on Twitter](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/ec2aba03a9ecb25a/60b1cb8de619207ac3d6b838967d376c/40203) or [VoteVanuch on Facebook](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/ec2aba03a9ecb25a/038fa3cb601b0501c3d6b838967d376c/40203)! **THANK YOU for your continued support of my campaign!** As your Congresswoman, I will fight for Virginia families, stop the Biden-Pelosi-Spanberger liberal agenda, and support commonsense policies that help all Virginians. Please forward this email and spread the word to your likeminded friends, family, and neighbors. We need proven conservative leadership that understands the needs of our community. Leadership you can _**_trust_**_. God bless,

It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** An opportunity to come clean for my opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and blocked a bipartisan commission to investigate the attack, still has yet to occur.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.

Nathan

Alexandria joined Instagram users last week for an _Ask Me Anything_ session where someone asked **“How does canceling student debt help us who paid their loans?”**
Here’s how she responded:

Warren and other colleagues to cancel up to $50,000 in federal student loan debt for borrowers.1
Last year, we asked you to share your stories of how student loan debt impacts you and your families. The stories we received were heartbreaking reminders of the cruel and painful burden of student loans.
We have seen the benefits that student loan cancellation can have since the emergency COVID-19 forbearance went into effect two years ago. The forbearance has given people the breathing room to take care of their families and to start investing in their futures.
No person should have to go into lifelong debt in order to get an education. It’s wrong. It’s backwards. And, it doesn’t help us as a country.

body:
Kevin is doing everything her can to restore America’s energy independence. Read more >>
| | | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/282e4263e04f74c17c94c760ea83e7c0/34143/a701f70e5811de91/59905c6b6047079ac3d6b838967d376c/34143)
---
Peter, Americans aren’t just paying more at the pump. They’re paying more for everything, because the cost of energy affects every aspect of our day-to-day lives. From the farm and ranch equipment to produce our food, to factories where our goods are manufactured, to the transportation to bring it all to the marketplace, to the cost of the electricity to keep the lights in those stores — _everything becomes more expensive when our fuel becomes more expensive_.
---
[**DONATE NOW - $20.22 - FOR AMERICAN ENERGY INDEPENDENCE >>**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/282e4263e04f74c17c94c760ea83e7c0/34143/a701f70e5811de91/529cc0e1dc68ea8bc3d6b838967d376c/34143)
---
Yet the Biden Administration has crippled our energy sector. On his first day in the Oval Office, Joe Biden shut down the Keystone XL pipeline. He also suspended federal oil and gas leases, and they continue to push the Green New Deal, which is a disaster waiting to happen. **The only solution to America’s energy crisis is to bring back our energy independence by unleashing our nation’s energy producers to do what they do best: Bring us affordable and reliable energy.**** ** Instead, they’re talking about buying oil from hostile powers like Iran and Venezuela! Kevin is fighting the battle for American energy independence, but he can’t do it without you. If you’re sick of how much you are paying at the pump (and how much you’re paying for everything else!), please rush a donation now to join Kevin in the fight.
---
[**DONATE NOW FOR AMERICAN ENERGY INDEPENDENCE >>**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/282e4263e04f74c17c94c760ea83e7c0/34143/a701f70e5811de91/71888ae8cfc56f5bc3d6b838967d376c/34143)
---
We can’t keep going like this. Americans need a reprieve from the cost of oil and gas, and we’re not going to get it by buying oil from hostile nations. We need energy independence, and we need it now. —Kevin Hern for Congress

| | |
---
**BREAKING: Ohio Democratic Party sues Gov. Mike DeWine’s administration over redacted records**
We just sued Governor Mike DeWine, team.

Since October, we have been working on getting answers to who knew what and when about the FirstEnergy scandal – which Ohioans continue to pay $287,000 every single day for – but have been stonewalled at every turn by the DeWine administration.

**The lack of accountability from DeWine is stunning.**

We want to know what Mike DeWine is hiding, what he knew, and when he knew about it throughout the HB6 scandal, but our records requests have gone mostly unanswered and the records that we have received were murky, at best, and heavily redacted.

I am writing to you with some deeply disappointing news, Peter. On Twitter, my opponent Lori Saine resorted to a personal attack that maligns not only myself, but every doctor who has ever worked in reproductive healthcare. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44976237/343917107/-419434573?refcode=fl_em_fr_20220505saine_yc_allop_xx_img1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YThiMzY5ZC1jZWNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wJY4DkVa71egt_dBYAa5IcOFzVH_jg6kKnreYUJ3jaY=)
---
On Monday, she also responded to the leak that the U.S. Supreme Court has voted to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ with a heart eyes emoji:
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44976238/343917108/-419434573?refcode=fl_em_fr_20220505saine_yc_allop_xx_img2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YThiMzY5ZC1jZWNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wJY4DkVa71egt_dBYAa5IcOFzVH_jg6kKnreYUJ3jaY=)
---
Not only is Lori’s first Tweet incorrect, but she seems to not understand that as a doctor, my role is to provide compassionate medical advice and care.
As a pediatrician, I’ve sat next to my patients and walked them through a heart-wrenching choice often made under difficult circumstances. _I’ve only had to inform a handful of young women that they’re pregnant, and I’ve been thankful that I can immediately go into a conversation about what their options are._
**As a healthcare provider, I give the pregnant patients that I care for choices about their futures. To live in a world where I have to tell them they have no choices is devastating.**
With _Roe_ overturned and Republicans on a crusade to ban abortion across the country, millions of people will lose that essential freedom. It’s not something to celebrate. It will result in the deaths of people who are unable to carry to term, and lead to many others seeking out unsafe, sometimes fatal abortions without proper medical care.
**Lori Saine is an anti-choice extremist who should not be in elected office.** Her attacks on me are reminiscent of rhetoric that have resulted in other medical providers being murdered in this anti-abortion culture war driven by conservatives.
We must support medical providers on the frontlines of abortion care for millions in need, and retire and replace elected officials who prioritize backtracking on 50 years of choice over sound science and other pressing policy work needed to support working families.
[**Please split a donation to my campaign and EMILY’s List, which exclusively endorses pro-choice women who will work to pass strong protections for our reproductive freedom, so we can keep up the fight for choice in Congress.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44976239/343917109/-419434573?refcode=fl_em_fr_20220505saine_yc_allop_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YThiMzY5ZC1jZWNjLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wJY4DkVa71egt_dBYAa5IcOFzVH_jg6kKnreYUJ3jaY=)
Thank you for your support, Peter. Here’s hoping Lori and her ilk can learn to be more civil in the future.
Dr. Yadira Caraveo

| Yadira Caraveo is a pediatrician, state representative, and daughter of immigrants. Her parents raised her and her siblings on her father’s construction worker’s salary in Adams County. In the legislature, Dr. Caraveo has delivered for working Coloradans by standing up to the biggest corporate bullies and entrenched special interests.

Now, Dr. Caraveo is running for Congress to stand up for hard-working families she sees falling through the cracks. Dr. Caraveo would be the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress and the only physician in Colorado’s congressional delegation. body:

---
Friend, It's been another busy week on the campaign trail with multiple dinners, forums, and meetings. We are now less than eight weeks out from the June 28th Primary Election. With more and more voters starting to pay attention, expect the dynamics of the race to change rapidly.
If $100M fell from the sky into the laps of each Republican candidate running for Illinois Governor, we would still be the only team that defeats JB Pritzker. That's because to win in Illinois you have to be able to do three things: 1) unify the Republican Party; 2) get crossover votes; and 3) survive the character assassination campaign that we all know is coming from the Democrats.
If you'd like to meet us on the trail or attend one of our fundraisers, you can check out our upcoming events by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/events?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_05_05_2022&n=2).
* * *
**Volunteer of the Week** Our volunteer to highlight this week is Chuck Borchsenius. Chuck is a long-time board member in LaSalle County. He and his son Gabe run the famous Norway Store on Route 71. In addition to posting and distributing our signs, Chuck has also been kind enough to endorse us. Thank you, Chuck, not only for your support, but also for your friendship!

****[If you'd like to volunteer on our campaign, click here.](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/volunteer?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_05_05_2022&n=3)
* * *
**Candidate Forums** We are still receiving positive feedback from the governor candidate forum in Tazewell County. If you'd like to watch the entire forum, you can do so by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sJ2NvuCm_uvAJn97pJvGm3mW9J1ti2_ZS91iHKirdRPVLXp4ry_HnUivj4FNLK3vXStULiFZv1FNDGxUHp7qPXHUewpAlaJ2A0Jox729hliseLpyLYDPmQnATbOGvZkOg&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=from_the_trail_05_05_2022&n=4).
We believe that if you can't face the voters and your fellow candidates in a forum, you don't have what it takes to face the Democrats in Springfield. The next forum we are scheduled to attend will be in St. Clair County on May 14th.

* * *
**Issue Discussion: More Legal Protection for Cops
** Like it or not, we have hate crimes laws on the books in Illinois. If you target an individual because of their membership in a protected group, criminal penalties are enhanced. If we are going to have this enhanced protection framework, no group is more deserving of increased protection than law enforcement (to include corrections officers) and first responders.
Putting our society's full support behind our law enforcement heroes is one part of making our families and communities safer. That's why we have included this additional protection as one of the six pillars in our "New Start for Illinois" policy agenda.
Thanks for reading this e-blast. We hope that the rest of your week goes well and we look forward to seeing you on the trail. S/F, Paul
Paid for by Citizens for Schimpf · P.O. Box 16, Waterloo, IL, 62298\. clean_body: | Friend, It's been another busy week on the campaign trail with multiple dinners, forums, and meetings. We are now less than eight weeks out from the June 28th Primary Election. With more and more voters starting to pay attention, expect the dynamics of the race to change rapidly. If $100M fell from the sky into the laps of each Republican candidate running for Illinois Governor, we would still be the only team that defeats JB Pritzker. That's because to win in Illinois you have to be able to do three things: 1) unify the Republican Party; 2) get crossover votes; and 3) survive the character assassination campaign that we all know is coming from the Democrats. If you'd like to meet us on the trail or attend one of our fundraisers, you can check out our upcoming events by clicking . Volunteer of the Week Our volunteer to highlight this week is Chuck Borchsenius. Chuck is a long-time board member in LaSalle County. He and his son Gabe run the famous Norway Store on Route 71. In addition to posting and distributing our signs, Chuck has also been kind enough to endorse us. Thank you, Chuck, not only for your support, but also for your friendship! Candidate Forums We are still receiving positive feedback from the governor candidate forum in Tazewell County. If you'd like to watch the entire forum, you can do so by clicking . We believe that if you can't face the voters and your fellow candidates in a forum, you don't have what it takes to face the Democrats in Springfield. The next forum we are scheduled to attend will be in St. Clair County on May 14th. Issue Discussion: More Legal Protection for Cops ** Like it or not, we have hate crimes laws on the books in Illinois. If you target an individual because of their membership in a protected group, criminal penalties are enhanced. If we are going to have this enhanced protection framework, no group is more deserving of increased protection than law enforcement (to include corrections officers) and first responders. Putting our society's full support behind our law enforcement heroes is one part of making our families and communities safer. That's why we have included this additional protection as one of the six pillars in our "New Start for Illinois" policy agenda. Thanks for reading this e-blast. We hope that the rest of your week goes well and we look forward to seeing you on the trail. S/F, Paul Paid for by Citizens for Schimpf · P.O. Box 16, Waterloo, IL, 62298\. Hi Peter, I've just published a new blog post: [The Defining Issue](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bjc8XUdeJ9yV6eR3mI9Z6HRd5urWv8u8i-Pa-jQzioo4ed14HHSc5T18wrHbIuLUIV0UXLzTT56X3ILUSGK2VA&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may5_final&n=1) Gavin Newsom spent the last two days talking about “rights” being taken away. This confused me. I thought we were in a State of Emergency where the concept of rights doesn’t exist. Newsom rushed out a new campaign ad calling the leaked Supreme Court opinion “the defining issue of the 2022 election." He even blasted Democrats for not being equally hyperbolic, asking, "Where the hell is my party?" Many likened it to a presidential campaign launch. If elected to Congress, I intend to fight Biden just as hard as I’ve fought Newsom. And if Newsom has any inkling of replacing Biden, I will be there to quash it – to make sure everyone knows just how badly he’s ruined California. In fact, we just learned our population declined by 117,552 last year. It’s not that we no longer have good weather; Ron DeSantis called Newsom’s home of San Francisco a “dumpster fire,” which is certainly too mild a description. Our hysterical governor aside, I believe the defining issue in 2022 is this: will we as a nation continue down the disastrous path of California, or will we return to the Founding principles that made America the greatest country in the world. I'm hopeful we’ll make the right choice, as wokeness gives way to a reawakening. Two powerful forces are about to meet: a state and nation run badly amok, and a movement of citizens determined to right the ship. I want to be a Congressman for all of the California conservatives and patriots who are part of that movement. This is the time to fight, and it's a privilege to be fighting with you. [Voting is about to start. Help me fight for the America we all believe in](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may5_final&n=2) [Share this Post on Facebook](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6lRRCK90LByd_IZ7SYQ32hXdGYSh_QNx24op8gCjcFPsRBdD_8OFMVw-LIYJSa42Tddj5oCw5s_eM-HSb9_EdFocDPst8NJfQxYLrft7js1XT2ElguRJBdFdeFms79-ERg&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may5_final&n=3) Kevin Kiley

_**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Peter,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Peter, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."_
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[Can I count on you to help me today?](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=914288ee61ec42a7af598ba1ff4bb6bb&_e=uO4-rFfZWNsZu7QKuVZvuqcAyxm5yjQAMBOn1wkqN-tNCZhdWG0C2BclupVbqLGH_zvDiBxA6C5urBae0vpYNVx1T1F6E905pgwnfIIEk_0iVC-xVAqk0JBPrGyaERz4TbOdr9Ru4F_lJatgx3ABr-jvrSxNtuHJSlGHw9GR2NKSvaCHWUMe67MhNOyNMw7eBx3Kew5GxXZzdH8a23QEK_IAYUV9fmoix_PZv2RCpXHSncN893AK8VYtnWGhxTof4lxDvfEdnYoAb8SfjB1YH3aupgyo_PLz4c9iOku1kjNONIrgpxJwbNL62Dtq2zKoYii1arXOQawXGiKgRgyIyRgd-5lCx8Y6a3rjbrR5lkIK4J9-oWIj8CUaFfbdP7Zu41-i29l--4DNbZn-C2lwQK8CwQ2f8r-A93xTVjTm0snt9BeWpcmbqwgkTYFa9FR3OLjw4p0fnK2NGDfi0NVjt3AFgU9q-vf4Sjx57Hol8iXcLypa8TXhwFMFwYK-dJk6)**

_Just imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat. They'd be fired immediately after going off air._

**I won't be quiet about this.** This columnist is saying horrible things about fellow human beings based on the color of their skin. That's simply wrong.

name: Alessandra Biaggi
subject: How we codified legal abortion in New York
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
#
Friends —
In light of the recent news that the Supreme Court is likely to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ , I wanted to talk about how personal and important the fight to codify _Roe_ is to me. Protecting abortion access has been the pillar of my entire career in government.
When I challenged State Senator Jeff Klein in 2018, he had a long history of obstructing progress on abortion rights in New York. Along with other fake Democrats supporting a Republican agenda in the Senate, Klein repeatedly blocked legislation that would have codified legal abortion. This was despite the fact that he had run for reelection year after a year as a pro-choice Democrat.
After Donald Trump’s victory, I knew that we couldn’t depend on _Roe_ being upheld to keep abortion safe and legal. Members of the state legislature had to act immediately to protect the right to an abortion.
That’s why I ran for office against Klein – the very man standing in the way of codifying _Roe_ – despite the fact that so many people were telling me I didn’t have a chance.
**In early 2019, just one month into my first term, New York finally passed the Reproductive Health Act into law, protecting the right to an abortion in our State.**
Now, in the event that _Roe_ is overturned, New York will remain a safe haven for individuals seeking abortions across the country.
But the truth is that _Roe_ being overturned will still be a disaster for anyone seeking reproductive healthcare in the United States. And truthfully, Democrats in the U.S. Senate need to fight harder to immediately suspend the filibuster and pass legislation affirming the right to an abortion. We are running out of time, and protecting the right to choose is a pillar of the Democratic Party.
As your representative for NY-3, I will do everything in my power to support access to reproductive healthcare, and hold accountable anyone standing in our way regardless of their party. But I’ll need your help to get there, so please:
[**Make a contribution of $5 to my campaign today to help me win this campaign and take my work supporting abortion rights to Congress.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-may/?refcode=em220505-1-15&refcode2=758_59515_r57mdO&akid=758%2E59515%2Er57mdO)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/biaggi-em-may/?refcode=em220505-1-15&refcode2=758_59515_r57mdO&akid=758%2E59515%2Er57mdO)**
Thank you for reading, and thank you for your support.
All my best,
Alessandra

We must do so because winning political power is the only way to meet this challenge — the only way to overcome this crisis.

Team,
You’ve probably heard me mention being part of something called the “Problem Solvers Caucus.” We’re a bipartisan group of representatives, equal parts Democrat and Republican, dedicated to working together to develop common sense solutions. People are often surprised to know that Democrats and Republicans still meet every week and work together on legislation. So today I thought I’d tell you a bit more about what being part of this group actually entails.
The process for getting in the Problem Solvers Caucus is a bit like Noah’s Ark. You find a member from the opposite party to link arms with and you can only join the caucus together. There are a few rules we abide by, namely, we all agree not to campaign against each other when election season rolls around.
So what exactly is it that we do? We meet every single week to discuss potential legislation and work through the main issues of the day. We often listen to talks by leaders and captains of industry. When Democrats and Republicans in the wider Congress can’t agree and it seems as though there’s no path forward, the Problem Solvers Caucus will often try to sit down and hammer out a compromise that we can then bring to our party leadership.
For example, when COVID relief negotiations stalled in 2020, we were able to pave the way forward and secure some much-needed assistance for the American people. And the Bipartisan Infrastructure Funding, which passed last November, came form a bipartisan outline the Problem Solvers Caucus worked on last spring.
Many of us in the Problem Solvers Caucus have different views, different backgrounds, and are elected in very different districts. But, we are able to find the areas where there is overlap and we work together.
It’s the way Congress is supposed to operate.

name: Morgan Harper
subject: An update from my campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Morgan Harper for Ohio
body:
I wanted to reach out to you personally and say thank you for all your support of my campaign for U.S. Senate.
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220505-1038-footer-ak&t=2&akid=1038%2E90090%2EZNe-Yk)
Hi,
You’ve probably heard the news already, but I wanted to reach out personally. On Tuesday evening, I called Congressman Ryan to congratulate him on his victory, and I wanted to reach out to you now, about this campaign and everything we’ve accomplished.
**First, I need to say thank you.** If you volunteered with us, invested in this campaign, voted in the primary on Tuesday, posted about the campaign on social media, or even just read our emails – thank you. From the bottom of my heart, I am so grateful for all of your support.
**Second, I want to talk about this campaign, which has been an incredible experience.** I’ve gotten the chance to travel across the state, meet Ohioans anywhere they’d take a minute to talk, and learn from them. And what I’ve learned over the course of this campaign is that Ohioans have a lot that they want from their leaders, and they have a lot that they’re not getting.
**They want universal healthcare.** People who I’ve met have told me time and again, they need access to high-quality healthcare, and that they’re tired of having to go into debt just to get the care that they need.
**They want to be paid a living wage.** I’ve met grandparents who are raising their grandchildren, and working in minimum wage jobs that barely cover their costs. We absolutely need a $15 federal minimum wage, and that is the floor, not the ceiling.
**They want access to high quality education,** and that starts with pre-k through 12. I’ve heard from kids, parents, and teachers across the state that they just aren’t getting what they need. We have to change that — and we have to fund schools equally, regardless of ZIP code.
**They want their rights to be protected.** Women in Ohio want the right to choose what they do with their own bodies. They want to be able to be who they are – to be gay, to be trans, and to not be discriminated against. They don’t want regressive policies from the GOP that seek to move us back in time.
**They truly want Ohio to be a state of the future. I do too.** If we want to get there, we absolutely can not let J.D. Vance win this Senate seat in November.
All the things that we know Ohioans want, and what my campaign has been about – creating hundreds of thousands of jobs in the clean energy economy, raising the minimum wage so it’s an actual living wage, supporting small businesses, and passing the PRO Act to strengthen unions – these aren’t things that J.D. Vance or the GOP care about or will fight to get done. And those are things that we absolutely must fight for.
Republicans will continue to drag us backwards, as we’re seeing at the federal level, with the horrifying news that SCOTUS plans to overturn _Roe v Wade_. I’ve heard from people across Ohio who have been afraid that this decision was coming – younger women who are wondering what this will mean for their futures, older women who are afraid that we’re going backwards, even after decades of fighting for progress. We can’t go back. We must defend abortion access
**It’s simple: we can’t afford to elect another Republican Senator from Ohio.**
**We must stand together to make sure that Ohio flips blue this fall, and I’m committed to making that happen.** When I spoke with Congressman Ryan earlier this week, I told him I will do whatever I can to help him in the coming months.
This campaign has been an incredible experience – and I want to make clear that you haven’t heard the last from me, Ohio. But right now I’m going to take a deep breath, maybe a long weekend, and then I’ll be right back fighting alongside you all.
**Thank you so much again.**
Onwards,
Morgan Harper

**__According to a leaked opinion, the Supreme Court is on the cusp of overturning Roe v. Wade and thus ending Federal protections for infanticide.__**

It is so important that we celebrate our victories, no matter how small. And this is no small victory.

_This is the culmination of half a century of God-fearing Patriots' prayers and hard work._

We've all been through a lot during these awful months of the Biden Occupation.

_Take a few moments, praise the Lord, and bask in the glory of this moment._

**The nationwide holocaust of millions of unborn babies is almost at its end. The greatest sin in American history is on its way out the door.**

The war isn't quite over, of course. Now, infanticide will be an issue for each state to handle.

We absolutely have to start calling our state legislators to make sure they are ready to totally criminalize abortion. We have to immediately capitalize on this victory at the state level.

We have to take national action to stop Blue States from continuing their industrial baby murder.

_With only 3 WEEKS left until Election Day, and my first TV ad on the way, your support is more critical now than it's ever been._ [It's time for leaders in D.C. who aren't afraid to stand up and fight for our most vulnerable citizens: the unborn.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=740568569e&e=eda539b26b)

[**_Help me_ _ defeat the Bipartisan Establishment __\-- Chip into my election campaign right away and show them the power of the America First movement_**](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=61dde08ea9&e=eda539b26b) _._

_We need PATRIOTS who will**FIGHT** for the **AMERICAN** people, not limp-waisted frauds who never miss an opportunity to stab us in the back._

[_**Your contributions to my campaign will help me purchase TV and radio ads, yard signs, and other campaign materials so I can fight the worthless GOP, retire a weak RINO, and replace him with a fierce America First Warrior**_.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=a633026265&e=eda539b26b)

body:
We need to be ready to fight back.
#
I don’t like to raise the alarm unless it’s called for, Derek.
But this is one of those moments.
**🔴 Donald Trump is hosting a big MAGA rally in ****Westmoreland County tomorrow night to support Dr. Oz. 🔴**
This is serious. We just saw in Ohio how Trump’s support can supercharge a Senate campaign. Trump + Dr. Oz sharing a stage is going to mean a MASSIVE wave of donations, support, and momentum in the press for Oz.
I need your help to fight back, starting *now*.
[**Will you donate any amount now to help raise $100,000 in emergency grassroots funds before Trump touches down in Pennsylvania?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220505-2?refcode=em20220505-5681&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=5681_434096_0U-52M&akid=5681%2E434096%2E0U-52M)
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220505-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220505-5681&refcode2=5681_434096_0U-52M&akid=5681%2E434096%2E0U-52M)**
A lot of people laughed when Dr. Oz (a celebrity doctor who doesn’t live in PA 🙄) jumped in our race. But I’ll repeat now what I said then:
**The worst thing we could do is underestimate Dr. Oz.**
First, Dr. Oz is already a self-funding millionaire who has spent _huge sums_ in the GOP’s record-breaking primary.
Second, Trump could endorse a freakin’ ham sandwich for U.S. Senate and Super PACs would still dump loads of money behind it. 🙄
Third, this huge MAGA rally in Pennsylvania is about to light a big fire under Trump’s base in Pennsylvania — making it all the harder for us to take on Dr. Oz.
Derek, I’m going to need your help to defeat this weirdo celebrity doctor who has the full backing of Donald Trump + virtually unlimited sums to spend in PA.
[**Can you rush your very first donation of $5 to help us raise an emergency fund of $100,000 before Trump and Oz take the stage together in Pennsylvania? We need a massive showing of grassroot support as soon as possible to overpower Trump’s involvement in this race.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220505-2?refcode=em20220505-5681&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=5681_434096_0U-52M&akid=5681%2E434096%2E0U-52M)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220505-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220505-5681&refcode2=5681_434096_0U-52M&akid=5681%2E434096%2E0U-52M)**
Thank you for stepping up,
John

John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**_THE PROBLEM ➡_**

We are facing an oppressive government who wants to strip us of our rights, ruin our economy, and dismantle our country. Democrats in DC have sold out our children’s futures for their own personal interests. As a nation, **we have lost trust in the people who are meant to SERVE us.**

**_THE SOLUTION ➡_**

[**Washington is in desperate need of proven leaders that understand holding public office begins with service to the people**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=721275be21cd4fc2b13c42c6548268db&_e=wRayJa76kps6h_j4cOoDHzzkSPzzolMLjEJ1pb4K8Jzy15hSebCi4RGRLn2sC8FGQWzIAznqXOt1iJwKsrfNtR8GjPV1PiJan8XiOOduUV0Ql7cEWowCA-DWOkRzYtW7oknKiRIELkrW7VT6pk-Meg1GwL8sR55F9DgJjyWPfwBLsikTm9Msi4ss-W59XJ7PbrxFER_YyLMN5OsrvlpNRUasnFbMvEK-5mZtWGmSOSn2XxVsUxnm9D1c328mBjgEci5TndxT2hA1xwSMVojOYblKIWWcW6ImDbjz6Us5HOfbD2pRR57GnzSK5aSYXjc_B8YiiPvzBO0mdX-0M5FqRvk7VtrqC3bx0BJ5ySQ0uzmjhcWUSx5BsYivro05wLxmNdriqceAsX2y794SHyiFrY0X8_jhVKxtW7nkSrZnAZfw31JcLspDotRwVpis3Lp4DACUnOZ5SFWBX7ku_H483y83G0cWmntfL87gGAzrTbHDpX2iIgblvGHNPcNM3Y-5) – _not someone who wants five seconds of fame on a news hit._

We don’t need another self-serving politician who is a yes-man for LIFELONG politician, Nancy Pelosi (like my opponent) – we need someone to put their head down and do the work of the people.

We don’t need another rambling mouthpiece that labels YOU as a terrorist for wanting a say in _**YOUR**_ child’s education – we need leaders that understand that the best parent for your child is **you** , not the government.

Earlier this week, a report from _Politico_ said that in a draft opinion, the Supreme Court voted to overturn _Roe v. Wade_.

First, let me make it clear: until a final ruling is made public, abortion remains legal in our country. **However, if this draft opinion is issued, it marks a massive step backward for reproductive rights.**

Thirteen states already have "trigger bans" in place which will make abortion illegal overnight if _Roe_ is overturned, and several more have passed extreme restrictions. Women in more than half of states will lose the freedom to make the most profoundly impactful healthcare decision of their lives -- when and whether to have a child.

Look, this feels like a punch in the gut. As a doctor, I know that deeply personal reproductive decisions should be between patient and doctor. The government should never be in charge of these decisions. Overturning _Roe_ will not stop abortions. It will push them later into pregnancy and make them less safe. And for those forced to carry a pregnancy they did not choose, that pregnancy carries real risks to their health. Consider that the maternal mortality rate in the United States is more than double the rate in Canada.

Last year, with my pro-choice colleagues in the House, I helped pass the Women's Health Protection Act to codify _Roe v. Wade_ and block states from enacting medically unjustified barriers to accessing abortion care. As the only pro-choice woman doctor in the House, I will continue to work to ensure that we protect this fundamental right for every woman, no matter where she lives -- but I need your help.

clean_body: A report released this week shows that the Supreme Court is poised to overturn Roe v. Wade, a devastating decision that would severely restrict or end all-together access to safe and legal abortion for millions of Americans. We are at a crisis moment for abortion access, Peter. A report released this week shows that the Supreme Court is poised to overturn Roe v. Wade , a devastating decision that would severely restrict or end all-together access to safe and legal abortion for millions of Americans. More than ever, we need pro-choice leaders in Congress who will fight back against these attacks on our reproductive care. As a doctor, Kim will do everything she can to protect access to safe abortion and codify Roe into law but she needs your support. = \----------Begin Forwarded Message---------- Sender: Dr. Kim Schrier Subject: I will do everything I can to protect abortion access Date: Wednesday, May 4, 2022 Team, Earlier this week, a report from Politico said that in a draft opinion, the Supreme Court voted to overturn Roe v. Wade. First, let me make it clear: until a final ruling is made public, abortion remains legal in our country. However, if this draft opinion is issued, it marks a massive step backward for reproductive rights. Thirteen states already have "trigger bans" in place which will make abortion illegal overnight if Roe is overturned, and several more have passed extreme restrictions. Women in more than half of states will lose the freedom to make the most profoundly impactful healthcare decision of their lives -- when and whether to have a child. Look, this feels like a punch in the gut. As a doctor, I know that deeply personal reproductive decisions should be between patient and doctor. The government should never be in charge of these decisions. Overturning Roe will not stop abortions. It will push them later into pregnancy and make them less safe. And for those forced to carry a pregnancy they did not choose, that pregnancy carries real risks to their health. Consider that the maternal mortality rate in the United States is more than double the rate in Canada. Last year, with my pro-choice colleagues in the House, I helped pass the Women's Health Protection Act to codify Roe v. Wade and block states from enacting medically unjustified barriers to accessing abortion care. As the only pro-choice woman doctor in the House, I will continue to work to ensure that we protect this fundamental right for every woman, no matter where she lives -- but I need your help. = Thank you, Kim To hold the House majority, we must re-elect Rep. Kim Schrier in WA-08. | **Vote Tomorrow!**
---
| Friends, Tomorrow starts a vital moment for our campaign. Each county in the 7th Congressional District starts early voting. This means you can go to your county's designated early voting location and cast your ballot, in-person!
---
| | |
---
| Early Voting Locations and Hours of Operation
---
| **Prince William County**
* Office of Elections - Conference Room, 9250 Lee Ave, Suite 1
* A.J. Ferlazzo Building - Lobby, 15941 Donald Curtis Drive

* Weekend Hours: Saturdays, June 11 & June 18 only - 8:30 am to 4:30 pm

* Weekend Hours: Saturdays, June 11 & June 18 only - 9:00 am to 5:00 pm

* Weekday Hours: Monday - Friday - 8:30 am - 4:30 pm
* Weekend Hours: Saturdays, June 11 & June 18 only - 9:00 am to 5:00 pm

| Last year's general election was a huge win for Republicans across the Commonwealth, especially for Governor Youngkin, Lt. Governor Sears, and Attorney General Jason Miyares. A part of that success started with early voting. Conservatives turned out to the polls weeks ahead of time to cast their ballots for our statewide ticket. This concerted effort allowed the campaigns to track who voted and target individuals who still needed persuaded or reminded about the election. This saves campaigns money, but also protects your vote. When you cast your ballot in person at an early voting location, your name comes off the list and no one else can request and absentee ballot under your name or show up to the polls and pretend they are you. Lastly, Republicans of the 7th District live busy lives. There is always a chance you may get busy with work, travel, or family on June 21st. Vote early so you don't have to worry about missing Election Day!

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

While the Supreme Court prepares to overturn Roe v. Wade, the number three
Democrat in the House, Rep. James Clyburn, is rallying voters on behalf of
Henry Cuellar — the only anti-abortion Democrat in the House.

Clyburn has doubled down his support of Cuellar. Just look at what he told
voters at a get-out-the-vote rally in San Antonio.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105905?refcode=em20220505-23208&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23208%2E1203867%2EaolR3f ]Screenshot of tweet that reads Clyburn urges early vote for Cuellar.
Tell 'em that you heard it from the No. 3 guy in the House ... the guy
who's got to count the votes, the guy who knows what it is to get a bill
passed, the guy who [inaudibe] to get the right guy nominated to be your
presidential nominee.

This isn’t the first time that Clyburn has rallied against progressive
champions. In 2020, Clyburn went all out in South Carolina to stop Bernie
Sanders from securing the Democratic nomination for president. And now, he
is bragging about that defeat while rallying for an anti-abortion
Democrat.

Jessica Cisneros is running to defeat Henry Cuellar, but she’s going up
against powerful forces in the Democratic establishment. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105905?refcode=em20220505-23208&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23208%2E1203867%2EaolR3f ]Will you make
a $3 donation to Justice Democrats so we can fight back and
elect someone who will fight for abortion rights in Congress?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105905?refcode=em20220505-23208&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23208%2E1203867%2EaolR3f ]Contribute

House leadership has now doubled down their support for a “Democrat” who
voted with Donald Trump 70% of the time. Cuellar is the last anti-abortion
Democrat in the House and voted against codifying Roe v. Wade.

Nancy Pelosi, James Clyburn, and other Democratic leaders have made it
clear that they back Cuellar 100% and will fight to keep him in Congress.
But at this critical moment in our nation’s history, that is not
acceptable.

We need Democrats in Congress who will fight for reproductive justice. If
you agree, [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105905?refcode=em20220505-23208&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=23208%2E1203867%2EaolR3f ]make a contribution to Justice Democrats so we can defeat
Henry Cuellar on May 24th.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105905?refcode=em20220505-23208&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=23208%2E1203867%2EaolR3f ]Contribute

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=23208%2E1203867%2EaolR3f ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the

| | | Dear Peter,

Like many of you, I’m still reeling from the Supreme Court leak about overturning _Roe v. Wade_. Despite nearly 50 years of legal precedent, the idea that women in many states will no longer be trusted to control their choices and their bodies is stunning.

**This race is about Choice too: a choice to send a different kind of leader to Congress. A leader with real skin in the game — a mom who will fight for legislation to make reproductive freedom permanent across the country, so that the reproductive rights of every single person are protected.** This is personal to me and to women across this district. This is a matter of life, death, and equity for so many. We won’t back down now or ever.

[**Will you join our campaign today to elect the pro-choice candidate we need fighting for us in Congress?**](https://emilybeachforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e1f6cc5ae5297bf855964ce9b&id=d060dc52d6&e=de8b2615ea)

name: Jayapal HQ
subject: FWD - Outraged and disgusted
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The Senate can protect abortion rights right now, but only if it ends the filibuster and passes the Women’s Health Protection Act.
#
Peter, did you see Pramila’s email from Tuesday? We didn’t see your name signed on to [**our petition urging the Senate to end the filibuster and protect abortion rights by passing the Women’s Health Protection Act.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220505-1239&t=1&akid=1239%2E420207%2ECqh5ys)
We were devastated by the news of the Supreme Court’s draft opinion overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , and we’re ready to fight back. **Can you add your name to the petition today?**
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220505-1239&t=2&akid=1239%2E420207%2ECqh5ys)**
And please, if you have a couple of minutes, read Pramila’s message below.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal
\-----Forwarded Message-----
Date: May 3, 2022
Sender: Pramila Jayapal
Subject: Outraged and disgusted
Peter,
As one of the one in four women in this country who have chosen to have an abortion, I am outraged and disgusted by the reported draft SCOTUS opinion overturning _Roe v. Wade_.
**The purpose of our Supreme Court is to uphold freedom and respect precedent — not to take away the fundamental freedom for pregnant people to make choices about their own bodies and futures.**
Right now, the Senate can pass an exception to the filibuster and codify _Roe v. Wade_. NOW is the moment to act, not next month or after the midterms. [**Will you add your name to our grassroots petition calling on the Senate to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act without delay?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220505-1239&t=3&akid=1239%2E420207%2ECqh5ys)
**[Add your name](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220505-1239&t=4&akid=1239%2E420207%2ECqh5ys)**
Let’s not forget that _Roe v. Wade_ was a 7-2 decision. The SCOTUS majority who voted to overturn it has no respect for precedent. No respect for pregnant people. No respect for voting rights. No respect for our democratic institutions.
The decision to have an abortion is an intensely personal choice about control of our own bodies. And the consequences of that choice are ones that only WE will have to live with — SCOTUS and Republican state legislatures have no business restricting our choices about our bodies.
[**The Senate can protect abortion rights right now, but only if it ends the filibuster and passes the Women’s Health Protection Act. We can’t wait any longer. If you agree, add your name to our petition today.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/senate-whpa-2022/?source=em20220505-1239&t=5&akid=1239%2E420207%2ECqh5ys)
I will continue to fight tooth and nail for every single person’s right to have a legal and safe abortion in this country. We will not accept this sitting down, and we WILL take this to the streets and the voting booth.
People are right to be scared by this news, but please remember: this is still a draft opinion, not a ruling. _Roe v. Wade_ is still the law of the land, and abortion is legal here in Washington State. **Take care of yourselves and each other.**
In solidarity,
Pramila

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220505-1239-footer&t=6&refcode2=1239_420207_Cqh5ys&akid=1239%2E420207%2ECqh5ys)**

| | | Peter,

Did you see the news? Our campaign just won the sole endorsement of California Environmental Voters (formerly known as the California League of Conservation Voters).

This endorsement is a big deal and a true honor, Peter. Climate change is one of my top priorities when I am in Congress.

My four-year-old twin sons, Liam and Landon, are going to grow up in a world that is far different than the world I was raised in. When I announced my candidacy, I announced my Liam and Landon Promise which has served as my north star as I navigate the nexus of state and federal climate policy. This promise is my commitment to the next generation. A commitment that I will do everything in my power to deliver meaningful climate legislation that will mitigate the worst impacts of our climate crisis, before it's too late.

As Assembly Speaker pro Tem, I’ve proven my commitment to protecting our fragile environment, proudly earning a 100% 2021 Environmental Scorecard and 98% lifetime rating from California Environmental Voters.

In Congress, I will keep fighting for bold climate action to protect our planet for future generations. But I need your help to get there.

We recently celebrated the 52nd anniversary of Earth Day [**and I’m asking you now to chip in $52 to ensure we have both the strongest coalition of endorsers AND the strongest war chest needed to win this race. **](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=00b2f99b3b&e=292fde286a)

Thank you for your support,

Kevin Mullin

# Weekly Update 5.5.2022
---
|
---
| | | |
---
**Friends: **
This week as we observe the National Day of Prayer, we take a look at the relationship our founder's intended between church and state. In recent years, the courts have taken an adversarial position that seems to evict God from government and public life. In this week's issue, we'll look at how this developed.
---
|
# **In this issue:**
* Recent Events
* National Day of Prayer
* Upcoming Events
* Important Developments
* Alan on the Issues

---
| **Recent Events:**
**Tuesday, April 26 th **\- Alan connected with citizens at the Meet and Greet in Eatonton last Tuesday. We appreciate you, **Putnam County!**

**Thursday, April 28 th \- **Alan was a guest speaker for the **Elbert County Republican Meeting**. What a wonderful time with great folks in Elberton!

**Sunday, May 1 st \- **Alan participated in the **Laudermilk-Young Debate** , hosted by the **Atlanta Press Club** and aired on**Georgia Public Broadcasting.**

Saturday, May 7th - 2:00 PM** \- Alan will participate in the **Jackson County 10th Congressional District Forum**.

**Monday, May 9th** \- Come on out and support your favorite candidate, Alan Sims, as all of our 10th district candidates discuss the issues one last time before the Primary on May 24. Hosted by the**Walton County GOP**. The location is **1025 Church** at 1025 E. Spring St., Monroe, GA.

|
**VOTE FOR ALAN MAY 24th in the Republican Primary! Early Voting begins May 2nd**

---
| **Important Developments:**
The [US supreme court](https://alansimsforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5abbc295c801dfce747b6d100&id=ac1c2fd3ff&e=bcd0e72a5a) has provisionally voted to overturn Roe v Wade, the landmark ruling that legalised abortion nationwide in America, according to a draft opinion reported on by Politico.

In what appeared to be a stunning and unprecedented leak, [Politico said](https://alansimsforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5abbc295c801dfce747b6d100&id=c1da6839ea&e=bcd0e72a5a) on Monday evening it had obtained an initial majority opinion written by Justice Samuel Alito and circulated in the court on 10 February.

The opinion strikes down [Roe v Wade](https://alansimsforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5abbc295c801dfce747b6d100&id=0a5d25b7b4&e=bcd0e72a5a), the court’s 1973 ruling that enshrined the supposed constitutional right to abortion, and a subsequent 1992 decision – Planned Parenthood v Casey – that largely upheld that decision.

Politico quoted Alito as saying: “Roe was egregiously wrong from the start. Its reasoning was exceptionally weak, and the decision has had damaging consequences. And far from bringing about a national settlement of the abortion issue, Roe and Casey have enflamed debate and deepened division.”
The justice adds: “We hold that Roe and Casey must be overruled. It is time to heed the constitution and return the issue of abortion to the people’s elected representatives.”

Four of the other Republican-appointed justices – Clarence Thomas, Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh and Amy Coney Barrett – voted with Alito in the conference held among the justices, the article added.

After an initial vote among the justices following oral argument, one is assigned the majority opinion and writes a draft. It is then circulated among the justices. At times, in between the initial vote and the ruling being released, the vote alignment can change. A ruling is only final when it is published by the court.

---
|
---
|
**Alan on the Issues:**
**Separation of Church and State**
Many believe the phrase “wall of separation between church and state” is in the Constitution. It is not. Rather, this modern belief stems from a 1947 Supreme Court Case, Everson v. Board of Education, in which Justice Hugo Black cited the phrase from a letter from President Thomas Jefferson to the Danbury Baptist Association.

**Did You Know?**
* The phrase “separation between church and state” does not appear in the Constitution
* Thomas Jefferson wrote the Statue for Religious Freedom for Virginia
* As Governor of Virginia, Jefferson called for a day of thanksgiving and prayer in 1779
* As President, Jefferson regularly attended church services held in the U.S. Capitol
* While serving as U.S. President, Thomas Jefferson was elected as the first president of the D.C. public school board, which used the Bible as a reading text in the classroom

| | | May 5, 2022 Hi Friends, October came in May this year.

Desperate for any excuse to turn the conversation from the Democrat’s failures at the border, the gas pump, the grocery store, the defunding of our police, national security, and so much more, some leftist stooge leaked the preliminary opinion from the SCOTUS decision on Roe v Wade. While we’ve learned to expect an “October surprise” from Democrats, America was caught off guard when this unprecedented political stunt dropped in early May.

The word “unprecedented” can scarcely describe the magnitude of what has happened here. While we’ve grown used to “oval office leaks” and even some “congressional leaks,” never before has a leak occurred from the once inviolate SCOTUS. But then, that’s part of the end-game of the left. The goal? To undermine every pillar of American government, faith, and the traditional family. They want us to be worker bees while the government manages every area of our lives—from working to wages, from restrooms to reproduction.

Today’s leftists wallow in a dark mindset of self-hatred and they are determined to drag the rest of us into their nihilistic vision for America, where life has no meaning and children are seen as burdens, not blessings.

Friends, I have a different worldview. I believe that life is precious and should be celebrated and protected. l believe that we were created in God’s image and that each person has a divine purpose—both the born and the unborn. Our Founding Fathers believed this too, and they declared boldly that we all have the basic right ... to life. Liberty and the pursuit of happiness don’t mean much if you’re denied the right to life.

If you share that belief, I need your help to get to Congress. We don’t need any more RINOs who consistently side with the party of darkness. Our nation needs a voice of hope and life—and we are at a moment in time where we can make sure it happens.

In the months leading up to the midterms, we should expect to see more riots, more lawlessness, and more messages of doom and gloom for America. I see a brighter future, where we lift people up and shine the bright light of freedom for all Americans, born and unborn. Please help me get to Congress by **[_donating here_](https://heidistjohnforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=46e715d1574a19c15defda548&id=f7c63fc389&e=b0bcc6b4f9)**

For Freedom,
